text:
Kibriyai Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki chadar hai. In ayaton mein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne us faislay ki khabar deta hai jo woh Akhirat ke din apne bandon ke darmiyan karega. Jo log apne dil se iman laye aur apne hath paon se mutabiq-e-shara nek niyati ke sath achay amal kiye unhein apne karam-o-rahm se Jannat ata farmaye ga, Rahmat se murad Jannat hai. Jaise Sahih Hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Jannat se farmaya tu meri rahmat hai jise main chahoon ga tujhe ata farmaoon ga, khuli kamyabi aur haqiqi murad ko hasil kar lena yahi hai. Aur jo log iman se ruk gaye balkay kufr kiya un se Qayamat ke din bator daant-dupat ke kaha jaye ga ke kya Allah Ta'ala ki ayatein tumhare samne nahin padhi jati thin? Yani yaqeenan padhi jati thin aur tumhein sunayi jati thin phir bhi tum ne ghuroor-o-nakhawat mein aa kar un ki itteba na ki. Balkay un se munh phere rahe apne dilon mein Allah Ta'ala ke farman ki takzeeb liye hue tum ne zahiran apne af'aal mein bhi us ki nafarmani ki, gunahon par gunah daleri se karte chale gaye aur Qayamat zaroor qaim hogi us ke aane mein koi shak nahin to tum palat kar jawab de diya karte the ke hum nahin jante Qayamat kise kehte hain? Hamein agarche kuch yun hi sa wahm hota hai lekin hargiz yaqeen nahin ke Qayamat zaroor aaye gi hi. Ab un ki bad-a'maliyon ki saza un ke samne aa gayi, apni ankhon apne kartoot ka badla dekh chuke aur jis azab-o-saza ka inkar karte the, jise mazaq mein udate the jis ka hona namumkin samajh rahe the un azabon ne unhein charon taraf se gher liya aur unhein har qisam ki bhalai se mayoos karne ke liye keh diya gaya ke hum tumhare sath wahi muamla karenge jaise koi kisi ko bhool jata hai, yani Jahannam mein jhonk kar phir tumhein kabhi achai se yaad bhi na karenge. Yeh badla hai us ka ke tum us din ki mulaqat ko bhulaye hue the, us ke liye tum ne koi amal na kiya, kyunke tum us ke aane ki sadaqat ke qail hi na the. Ab tumhara thikana Jahannam hai aur koi nahin jo tumhari kisi qisam ki madad kar sake. Sahih Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne ba'az bandon se Qayamat ke din farmaye ga kya main ne tujhe baal-bachay nahin diye the? Kya main ne tujh par duniya mein in'am-o-ikram nazil nahin farmaye the? Kya main ne tere liye unton aur ghoron ko muti' aur farmabardar nahin kiya tha? Aur tujhe chhor diya tha ke suroor-o-khushi ke sath apne makanat aur haveliyon mein azadi ki zindagi basar kare? Yeh jawab de ga ke mere Parwardigar yeh sab sach hai beshak tere yeh tamam ehsanat mujh par the. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga pas aaj main tujhe is tarah bhula doon ga jis tarah tu mujhe bhool gaya tha. Phir farmata hai ke yeh sazayein tumhein isliye di gayi hain ke tum ne Allah Ta'ala ki ayaton ka khoob mazaq udaya tha. Aur duniya ki zindagi ne tumhein dhoke mein daal rakha tha tum isi par mutma'in the aur is qadar tum ne be-fikri barti ke akhir aaj nuqsan aur khasare mein par gaye.

Ab tum dozakh se nikale na jao ge aur na tum se hamari khafgi ke door karne ki koi wajah talab ki jaye gi yani is azaab se tumhara chhutkara bhi muhaal aur ab meri razamandi ka tumhein hasil hona bhi namumkin. Jaise ke momin baghair azaab-o-hisaab ke jannat mein jayenge. Aise hi tum be-hisaab azaab kiye jao ge aur tumhari tauba be-sood rahe gi. Apne is faisle ko jo mominon aur kafiron mein ho gaya bayan farma kar ab irshad farmata hai ke tamam hamd zameen-o-aasman aur har cheez ke maalik Allah Ta'ala hi ke liye hai. Jo kul jahan ka paal-nehar hai usi ko kibriyai yani saltanat aur badai aasmanon aur zameeno mein hai woh badi azmat aur buzurgi wala hai. Har cheez us ke samne past hai har ek us ka mohtaj hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith-e-qudsi mein hai Allah Ta'ala jalla wa ala farmata hai azmat mera tehband hai aur kibriyai meri chadar hai jo shakhs in mein se kisi ko bhi mujh se lena chahe ga main use jahannam raseed kar dunga. Yani badai aur takabbur karne wala dozakhi hai. Woh Aziz hai yani ghalib hai jo kabhi kisi se maghloob nahin hone ka koi nahin jo us par rok tok kar sake. Us ke samne pad sake woh Hakim hai. Us ka koi qaul koi fe'l us ki shariat ka koi masla us ki likhi hui taqdeer ka koi harf hikmat se khali nahin na us ke siwa koi masjood. Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam aur us ke lutf-o-rahm se Surah Jasiyah ki tafsir khatam hui aur isi ke sath pachiswein pare ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.

Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke is Quran-e-Karim ko usne apne bande aur apne sachay Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil farmaya hai aur bayan farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala aisi bari izzat wala hai jo kabhi kam na hogi. Aur aisi zabardast hikmat wala hai jis ka koi qaul koi fe'l hikmat se khali nahin phir irshad farmata hai ke aasman-o-zameen waghera tamam cheezein usne abas aur batil paida nahin keen balkay sarasar haq ke sath aur behtareen tadbeer ke sath banayi hain aur in sab ke liye waqt muqarrar hai jo na ghatay na barhay. Is Rasool se is kitab se aur Allah ke daraway ki aur nishaniyon se jo bad-batin log be-parwahi aur la-ubali karte hain unhein anqareeb maloom ho jaye ga ke unhon ne kis qadar khud apna hi nuqsan kiya. Phir farmata hai zara in mushrikeen se poocho to ke Allah ke siwa jin ke naam tum poojtay ho jinhein tum pukartay ho aur jin ki ibadat karte ho zara mujhe bhi to un ki taqat qudrat dikhao batao to zameen ke kis tukray ko khud unhon ne banaya hai? Ya sabit to karo ke aasmanon mein un ki shirkat kitni hai aur kahan hai? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aasman hon ya zameenein hon ya aur cheezein hon in sab ka paida karne wala sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Bajuz is ke kisi ko ek zarray ka bhi ikhtiyar nahin tamam mulk ka malik wahi hai woh har cheez par kamil tasarruf aur qabza rakhne wala hai tum us ke siwa dusron ki ibadat kyun karte ho? Kyun us ke siwa dusron ko apni museebaton mein pukartay ho? Tumhein yeh taleem kis ne di? Kis ne yeh shirk tumhein sikhaya? Dar-asal kisi bhalay aur samajhdar shakhs ki yeh taleem nahin ho sakti. Na Allah ne yeh taleem di hai agar tum Allah ke siwa auron ki pooja par koi aasmani daleel rakhtay ho to achha is kitab ko to janay do aur koi aasmani sahifa hi pesh kar do. Achha na sahi apne maslak par koi daleel-e-ilm hi qaim karo lekin yeh to jab ho sakta hai ke tumhara yeh fe'l sahih bhi ho is batil fe'l par to na to tum koi naqli daleel pesh kar sakte ho na aqli. Ek qira'at mein aayat (Au asaratim min ilm) yani koi sahih ilm ki naqal aglon se hi pesh karo. Hazrat Mujahid farmatay hain matlab yeh hai ke kisi ko pesh karo jo ilm ki naqal kare. Ibn Abbas farmatay hain is amr ki koi bhi daleel le aao. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai is se murad ilmi tehreer hai rawi kehte hain mera to khayal hai yeh hadith marfoo hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Ayyash farmatay hain murad baqiya ilm hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmatay hain kisi makhfi daleel ko hi pesh kar do. In aur buzurgon se yeh bhi manqool hai ke murad is se agli tehreerein hain. Hazrat Qatada farmatay hain koi khas ilm, aur yeh sab aqwal qareeb qareeb ham-ma'ni hain.

Murad wahi hai jo hum ne shuru mein bayan kar di, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne bhi isi ko ikhtiyar kiya hai. Phir farmata hai is se barh kar koi gumrah-karda nahin jo Allah ko chor kar buton ko pukare aur us se hajatein talab kare, jin hajaton ko pura karne ki un mein taqat hi nahin, balkeh woh toh is se bhi be-khabar hain, na kisi cheez ko le de sakte hain, is liye keh woh toh patthar hain, jamadat mein se hain. Qayamat ke din jab sab log ikhatte kiye jayenge toh yeh maboodan-e-batil apne abidon ke dushman ban jayenge aur is baat se keh yeh log un ki puja karte thay, saaf inkar kar jayenge. Jaise Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka aur jagah irshad hai, ayat: (Wa-ittakhazu min dunillahi alihatan liyakunu lahum izza) (Surah Maryam: 81), yani in logon ne Allah ke siwa aur mabood bana rakhe hain taake woh un ki izzat ka ba'is banein. Waqia aisa nahin balkeh woh toh un ki ibadat ka inkar kar jayenge aur un ke pure mukhalif ho jayenge, yani jab keh yeh un ke pure mohtaj honge us waqt woh un se munh pher lenge. Hazrat Khalil (A.S) ne apni ummat se farmaya tha, ayat: (Innamattakhaztum min dunillahi ausanan mawaddata bainikum fil-hayatid-dunya, summa yaumal-qiyamati yakfuru ba'dukum bibad'in wa yal'anu ba'dukum ba'dan, wa ma'wakumun-naru wa ma lakum min nasirin) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 25), yani tum ne Allah ke siwa buton se jo talluqat qaim kar liye hain us ka natija Qayamat ke din dekh lo ge, jab keh tum ek dusre se inkar kar jao ge aur ek dusre par la'nat karne lago ge aur tumhari jagah Jahannam muqarrar aur muta'in ho jayegi aur tum apna madadgar kisi ko na pao ge.

Jaise Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka aur jagah irshad hai, ayat: (Wa-ittakhazu min dunillahi alihatan liyakunu lahum izza) (Surah Maryam: 81), yani in logon ne Allah ke siwa aur mabood bana rakhe hain taake woh un ki izzat ka ba'is banein. Waqia aisa nahin balkeh woh toh un ki ibadat ka inkar kar jayenge aur un ke pure mukhalif ho jayenge, yani jab keh yeh un ke pure mohtaj honge us waqt woh un se munh pher lenge. Hazrat Khalil (A.S) ne apni ummat se farmaya tha, ayat: (Innamattakhaztum min dunillahi ausanan mawaddata bainikum fil-hayatid-dunya, summa yaumal-qiyamati yakfuru ba'dukum bibad'in wa yal'anu ba'dukum ba'dan, wa ma'wakumun-naru wa ma lakum min nasirin) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 25), yani tum ne Allah ke siwa buton se jo talluqat qaim kar liye hain us ka natija Qayamat ke din dekh lo ge, jab keh tum ek dusre se inkar kar jao ge aur ek dusre par la'nat karne lago ge aur tumhari jagah Jahannam muqarrar aur muta'in ho jayegi aur tum apna madadgar kisi ko na pao ge.

Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke is Quran-e-Karim ko usne apne bande aur apne sachay Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par nazil farmaya hai aur bayan farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala aisi bari izzat wala hai jo kabhi kam na hogi. Aur aisi zabardast hikmat wala hai jis ka koi qaul koi fe'l hikmat se khali nahin phir irshad farmata hai ke aasman-o-zameen waghera tamam cheezein usne abas aur batil paida nahin keen balkay sarasar haq ke sath aur behtareen tadbeer ke sath banayi hain aur in sab ke liye waqt muqarrar hai jo na ghatay na barhay. Is Rasool se is kitab se aur Allah ke daraway ki aur nishaniyon se jo bad-batin log be-parwahi aur la-ubali karte hain unhein anqareeb maloom ho jaye ga ke unhon ne kis qadar khud apna hi nuqsan kiya. Phir farmata hai zara in mushrikeen se poocho to ke Allah ke siwa jin ke naam tum poojtay ho jinhein tum pukartay ho aur jin ki ibadat karte ho zara mujhe bhi to un ki taqat qudrat dikhao batao to zameen ke kis tukray ko khud unhon ne banaya hai? Ya sabit to karo ke aasmanon mein un ki shirkat kitni hai aur kahan hai? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aasman hon ya zameenein hon ya aur cheezein hon in sab ka paida karne wala sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Bajuz is ke kisi ko ek zarray ka bhi ikhtiyar nahin tamam mulk ka malik wahi hai woh har cheez par kamil tasarruf aur qabza rakhne wala hai tum us ke siwa dusron ki ibadat kyun karte ho? Kyun us ke siwa dusron ko apni museebaton mein pukartay ho? Tumhein yeh taleem kis ne di? Kis ne yeh shirk tumhein sikhaya? Dar-asal kisi bhalay aur samajhdar shakhs ki yeh taleem nahin ho sakti. Na Allah ne yeh taleem di hai agar tum Allah ke siwa auron ki pooja par koi aasmani daleel rakhtay ho to achha is kitab ko to janay do aur koi aasmani sahifa hi pesh kar do. Achha na sahi apne maslak par koi daleel-e-ilm hi qaim karo lekin yeh to jab ho sakta hai ke tumhara yeh fe'l sahih bhi ho is batil fe'l par to na to tum koi naqli daleel pesh kar sakte ho na aqli. Ek qira'at mein aayat (Au asaratim min ilm) yani koi sahih ilm ki naqal aglon se hi pesh karo. Hazrat Mujahid farmatay hain matlab yeh hai ke kisi ko pesh karo jo ilm ki naqal kare. Ibn Abbas farmatay hain is amr ki koi bhi daleel le aao. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai is se murad ilmi tehreer hai rawi kehte hain mera to khayal hai yeh hadith marfoo hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Ayyash farmatay hain murad baqiya ilm hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmatay hain kisi makhfi daleel ko hi pesh kar do. In aur buzurgon se yeh bhi manqool hai ke murad is se agli tehreerein hain. Hazrat Qatada farmatay hain koi khas ilm, aur yeh sab aqwal qareeb qareeb ham-ma'ni hain.

Murad wahi hai jo hum ne shuru mein bayan kar di, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne bhi isi ko ikhtiyar kiya hai. Phir farmata hai is se barh kar koi gumrah-karda nahin jo Allah ko chor kar buton ko pukare aur us se hajatein talab kare, jin hajaton ko pura karne ki un mein taqat hi nahin, balkeh woh toh is se bhi be-khabar hain, na kisi cheez ko le de sakte hain, is liye keh woh toh patthar hain, jamadat mein se hain. Jaise Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka aur jagah irshad hai, ayat: (Wa-ittakhazu min dunillahi alihatan liyakunu lahum izza) (Surah Maryam: 81), yani in logon ne Allah ke siwa aur mabood bana rakhe hain taake woh un ki izzat ka ba'is banein. Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ) ka izhar-e-bebasi, mushrikon ki sarkashi aur un ka kufr bayan ho raha hai ke jab unhein Allah ki zahir-o-batin wazeh aur saaf aayatein sunayi jati hain to keh dete hain ke yeh to sarih jadu hai. Takzeeb-o-iftira, zalalat-o-kufr goya un ka shewa ho gaya hai. Jadu keh kar hi bas nahin karte balkay yun bhi kehte hain ke isay to Muhammad (ﷺ) ne ghar liya hai. Pas Nabi ki zabani Allah jawab dilwata hai ke agar main ne hi is Quran ko banaya hai aur main is ka saccha Nabi nahin to yaqeenan woh mujhe mere is jhoot aur bohtan par sakht tar azab kare ga aur phir tum kya saare jahan mein koi aisa nahin jo mujhe us ke azabon se chura sake. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Qul inni lan yujirani minallahi ahadun wa lan ajida min dunihi multahada) (72-Al-Jinn: 22), yani tu keh de ke mujhe Allah ke hath se koi nahin bacha sakta aur na us ke siwa kahin aur mujhe panah ki jagah mil sake gi lekin main Allah ki tabligh aur us ki risalat ko baja lata hoon. Aur jagah hai aayat (Wa law taqawwala alaina ba'dal aqawil) (69-Al-Haqqah: 44), yani agar yeh hum par koi baat bana leta, to hum us ka dahna hath pakar kar us ki rag-e-gardan kaat daalte aur tum mein se koi bhi isay na bacha sakta. Phir kuffar ko dhamkaya ja raha hai ke tumhari guftagu ka pura ilm us Aleem Allah ko hai, wahi mere aur tumhare darmiyan faisla kare ga. Us ki dhamki ke baad unhein tauba aur inabat ki raghbat dilayi ja rahi hai aur farmata hai woh Ghafoor-o-Rahim hai, agar tum us ki taraf ruju karo, apne kartoot se baaz aao to woh bhi tumhein bakhsh de ga aur tum par raham kare ga. Surah Furqan mein bhi isi mazmoon ki aayat hai. Farman hai aayat (Wa qalu asatirul awwaliniktatabaha fahiya tumla alaihi bukrataw wa asila) (25-Al-Furqan: 5), yani yeh kehte hain ke yeh aglon ki kahaniyan hain jo is ne likh li hain aur subh-o-sham likhayi ja rahi hain, to keh de ke isay us Allah ne utara hai jo har posheeda cheez janta hai, khwah aasmanon mein ho khwah zameen mein ho, woh Ghafoor-o-Rahim hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke main duniya mein koi pehla Nabi to nahin. Mujh se pehle bhi to duniya mein logon ki taraf Rasool aate rahe, phir mere aane se tumhein is qadar achambha kyun hua? Mujhe to yeh bhi nahin maloom ke mere sath kya kya jaye ga? Baqol Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is aayat ke baad aayat (Liyaghfira lakallahu ma taqaddama min zambika wa ma ta'akhara wa yutimma ni'matahu alaika wa yahdiyaka siratam mustaqima) (48-Al-Fath: 2), utri hai. Isi tarah Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi isay mansookh batate hain. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab aayat-e-bakhshish utri jis mein farmaya gaya taake Allah tere agle pichle gunah bakhshe to ek sahabi ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh to Allah ne bayan farma diya ke woh aap ke sath kya karne wala hai, pas woh hamare sath kya karne wala hai?

Is par aayat (لِّيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّاٰتِهِمْ ۭ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا ۙ) (Surah Al-Fath: 5) utri yani taake Allah momin mardon aur momin aurton ko aisi jannaton mein dakhil kare jin ke neeche nehrein behti hain. Sahih hadith se bhi yeh toh sabit hai ke mominon ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap ko mubarak ho, farmaiye hamare liye kya hukm hai? Is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari. Hazrat Zahhak (R.A) is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke matlab yeh hai ke mujhe nahin maloom ke main kya hukm diya jaon aur kis cheez se rok diya jaon? Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke is aayat se murad yeh hai ke aakhirat ka anjam toh mujhe qatan maloom hai ke main jannat mein jaunga, haan dunyawi haal maloom nahin ke agle baaz ambiya ki tarah qatl kiya jaon ya apni zindagi ke din poore kar ke Allah ke haan jaon? Aur isi tarah main nahin keh sakta ke tumhein dhansaya jaye ya tum par patthar barsaye jayen. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko motabar kehte hain aur filwaqai hai bhi yeh theek. Aap (ﷺ) bil-yaqeen jante the ke aap aur aap ke pairau jannat mein hi jayenge aur duniya ki halat ke anjam se aap be-khabar the ke anjam-e-kaar aap ka aur aap ke mukhalifeen Quraish ka kya haal hoga? Aaya woh imaan layenge ya kufr par hi rahenge aur azaab kiye jayenge ya bilkul hi halak kar diye jayenge. Lekin jo hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Umm-ul-Ala (R.A) farmati hain jinhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se bai'at ki thi ke jis waqt muhajireen bazariya qura-andazi ansariyon mein taqseem ho rahe the us waqt hamare hisse mein Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) aaye. Aap hamare haan bimar huye aur faut bhi ho gaye. Jab hum aap ko kafan pehna chuke aur Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi tashreef la chuke toh mere munh se nikal gaya, "Aye Abu-us-Saib! Allah tujh par raham kare, meri toh tujh par gawahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala yaqeenan tera ikram hi karega." Is par Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Tumhein kaise maloom ho gaya ke Allah Ta'ala yaqeenan is ka ikram hi karega?" Main ne kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ) par mere maa-baap fida hon, mujhe kuch nahin maloom." Pas aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Suno! Un ke paas toh un ke Rab ki taraf ka yaqeen aa pahuncha aur mujhe in ke liye bhalai aur khair ki umeed hai. Qasam hai Allah ki, bawajood Rasool hone ke main nahin janta ke mere sath kya sulook kiya jayega?" Is par main ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Ab is ke baad main kisi ki barat nahin karungi" aur mujhe is ka bada sadma hua. Lekin main ne khwab mein dekha ke Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) ki ek nahar beh rahi hai. Main ne aakar Huzoor (ﷺ) se is ka zikr kiya toh aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Yeh in ke a'maal hain." Yeh hadith Bukhari mein hai, Muslim mein nahin aur is ki ek sanad mein hai, "Main nahin janta bawajood-e-ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon ke is ke sath kya sulook kiya jayega?"

Dil ko toh kuch aisa lagta hai ke yahi alfaaz mauqa ke lihaz se theek hain kyunke is ke baad hi yeh jumla hai ke mujhe is baat se bada sadma hua. Al-garz yeh hadith aur isi ki hum-ma'ni aur hadithein dalalat hain is amr par ke kisi mu'ayyan shakhs ke jannati hone ka qat'i ilm kisi ko nahin, na kisi ko aisi baat zaban se kehni chahiye. Bajuz un buzurgon ke jin ke naam le kar Shari' (Alaihis Salam) ne unhein jannati kaha hai jaise Ashra-e-Mubashara aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Salam aur Umaisa aur Bilal aur Suraqa aur Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram jo Hazrat Jabir ke walid hain aur woh sattar qari jo Be'r-e-Ma'una ki jang mein shaheed kiye gaye aur Zaid bin Haritha aur Ja'far aur Ibn-e-Rawaha aur in jaise aur buzurg (Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een). Phir farmata hai Nabi (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum keh do ke main toh sirf us wahi ka muti' hoon jo Allah ki janab se meri janib aaye aur main toh sirf darane wala hoon ke khol khol kar har shakhs ko aagah kar raha hoon, har aqalmand mere mansab se ba-khabar hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Takzeeb-o-iftira, zalalat-o-kufr goya un ka shewa ho gaya hai. Jadu keh kar hi bas nahin karte balkay yun bhi kehte hain ke isay to Muhammad (ﷺ) ne ghar liya hai. Pas Nabi ki zabani Allah jawab dilwata hai ke agar main ne hi is Quran ko banaya hai aur main is ka saccha Nabi nahin to yaqeenan woh mujhe mere is jhoot aur bohtan par sakht tar azab kare ga aur phir tum kya saare jahan mein koi aisa nahin jo mujhe us ke azabon se chura sake. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Qul inni lan yujirani minallahi ahadun wa lan ajida min dunihi multahada) (72-Al-Jinn: 22), yani tu keh de ke mujhe Allah ke hath se koi nahin bacha sakta aur na us ke siwa kahin aur mujhe panah ki jagah mil sake gi lekin main Allah ki tabligh aur us ki risalat ko baja lata hoon. Aur jagah hai aayat (Wa law taqawwala alaina ba'dal aqawil) (69-Al-Haqqah: 44), yani agar yeh hum par koi baat bana leta, to hum us ka dahna hath pakar kar us ki rag-e-gardan kaat daalte aur tum mein se koi bhi isay na bacha sakta. Phir kuffar ko dhamkaya ja raha hai ke tumhari guftagu ka pura ilm us Aleem Allah ko hai, wahi mere aur tumhare darmiyan faisla kare ga. Us ki dhamki ke baad unhein tauba aur inabat ki raghbat dilayi ja rahi hai aur farmata hai woh Ghafoor-o-Rahim hai, agar tum us ki taraf ruju karo, apne kartoot se baaz aao to woh bhi tumhein bakhsh de ga aur tum par raham kare ga. Surah Furqan mein bhi isi mazmoon ki aayat hai. Farman hai aayat (Wa qalu asatirul awwaliniktatabaha fahiya tumla alaihi bukrataw wa asila) (25-Al-Furqan: 5), yani yeh kehte hain ke yeh aglon ki kahaniyan hain jo is ne likh li hain aur subh-o-sham likhayi ja rahi hain, to keh de ke isay us Allah ne utara hai jo har posheeda cheez janta hai, khwah aasmanon mein ho khwah zameen mein ho, woh Ghafoor-o-Rahim hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke main duniya mein koi pehla Nabi to nahin. Mujh se pehle bhi to duniya mein logon ki taraf Rasool aate rahe, phir mere aane se tumhein is qadar achambha kyun hua? Mujhe to yeh bhi nahin maloom ke mere sath kya kya jaye ga? Baqol Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is aayat ke baad aayat (Liyaghfira lakallahu ma taqaddama min zambika wa ma ta'akhara wa yutimma ni'matahu alaika wa yahdiyaka siratam mustaqima) (48-Al-Fath: 2), utri hai. Isi tarah Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi isay mansookh batate hain. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab aayat-e-bakhshish utri jis mein farmaya gaya taake Allah tere agle pichle gunah bakhshe to ek sahabi ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh to Allah ne bayan farma diya ke woh aap ke sath kya karne wala hai, pas woh hamare sath kya karne wala hai?

Is par aayat (لِّيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّاٰتِهِمْ ۭ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا ۙ) (Surah Al-Fath: 5) utri yani taake Allah momin mardon aur momin aurton ko aisi jannaton mein dakhil kare jin ke neeche nehrein behti hain. Sahih hadith se bhi yeh toh sabit hai ke mominon ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap ko mubarak ho, farmaiye hamare liye kya hukm hai? Is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari. Hazrat Zahhak (R.A) is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke matlab yeh hai ke mujhe nahin maloom ke main kya hukm diya jaon aur kis cheez se rok diya jaon? Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke is aayat se murad yeh hai ke aakhirat ka anjam toh mujhe qatan maloom hai ke main jannat mein jaunga, haan dunyawi haal maloom nahin ke agle baaz ambiya ki tarah qatl kiya jaon ya apni zindagi ke din poore kar ke Allah ke haan jaon? Aur isi tarah main nahin keh sakta ke tumhein dhansaya jaye ya tum par patthar barsaye jayen. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko motabar kehte hain aur filwaqai hai bhi yeh theek. Aap (ﷺ) bil-yaqeen jante the ke aap aur aap ke pairau jannat mein hi jayenge aur duniya ki halat ke anjam se aap be-khabar the ke anjam-e-kaar aap ka aur aap ke mukhalifeen Quraish ka kya haal hoga? Aaya woh imaan layenge ya kufr par hi rahenge aur azaab kiye jayenge ya bilkul hi halak kar diye jayenge. Lekin jo hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Umm-ul-Ala (R.A) farmati hain jinhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se bai'at ki thi ke jis waqt muhajireen bazariya qura-andazi ansariyon mein taqseem ho rahe the us waqt hamare hisse mein Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) aaye. Aap hamare haan bimar huye aur faut bhi ho gaye. Jab hum aap ko kafan pehna chuke aur Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi tashreef la chuke toh mere munh se nikal gaya, "Aye Abu-us-Saib! Allah tujh par raham kare, meri toh tujh par gawahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala yaqeenan tera ikram hi karega." Is par Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Tumhein kaise maloom ho gaya ke Allah Ta'ala yaqeenan is ka ikram hi karega?" Main ne kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ) par mere maa-baap fida hon, mujhe kuch nahin maloom." Pas aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Suno! Un ke paas toh un ke Rab ki taraf ka yaqeen aa pahuncha aur mujhe in ke liye bhalai aur khair ki umeed hai. Qasam hai Allah ki, bawajood Rasool hone ke main nahin janta ke mere sath kya sulook kiya jayega?" Is par main ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Ab is ke baad main kisi ki barat nahin karungi" aur mujhe is ka bada sadma hua. Lekin main ne khwab mein dekha ke Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) ki ek nahar beh rahi hai. Main ne aakar Huzoor (ﷺ) se is ka zikr kiya toh aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Yeh in ke a'maal hain." Yeh hadith Bukhari mein hai, Muslim mein nahin aur is ki ek sanad mein hai, "Main nahin janta bawajood-e-ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon ke is ke sath kya sulook kiya jayega?"

Lekin jo hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Umm-ul-Ala (R.A) farmati hain jinhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se bai'at ki thi ke jis waqt muhajireen bazariya qura-andazi ansariyon mein taqseem ho rahe the us waqt hamare hisse mein Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) aaye. Aap hamare haan bimar huye aur faut bhi ho gaye. Jab hum aap ko kafan pehna chuke aur Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi tashreef la chuke toh mere munh se nikal gaya, "Aye Abu-us-Saib! Allah tujh par raham kare, meri toh tujh par gawahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala yaqeenan tera ikram hi karega." Is par Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Tumhein kaise maloom ho gaya ke Allah Ta'ala yaqeenan is ka ikram hi karega?" Main ne kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ) par mere maa-baap fida hon, mujhe kuch nahin maloom." Pas aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Suno! Un ke paas toh un ke Rab ki taraf ka yaqeen aa pahuncha aur mujhe in ke liye bhalai aur khair ki umeed hai. Qasam hai Allah ki, bawajood Rasool hone ke main nahin janta ke mere sath kya sulook kiya jayega?" Is par main ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Ab is ke baad main kisi ki barat nahin karungi" aur mujhe is ka bada sadma hua. Lekin main ne khwab mein dekha ke Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) ki ek nahar beh rahi hai. Main ne aakar Huzoor (ﷺ) se is ka zikr kiya toh aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Yeh in ke a'maal hain." Yeh hadith Bukhari mein hai, Muslim mein nahin aur is ki ek sanad mein hai, "Main nahin janta bawajood-e-ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon ke is ke sath kya sulook kiya jayega?"

Dil ko toh kuch aisa lagta hai ke yahi alfaaz mauqa ke lihaz se theek hain kyunke is ke baad hi yeh jumla hai ke mujhe is baat se bada sadma hua. Al-garz yeh hadith aur isi ki hum-ma'ni aur hadithein dalalat hain is amr par ke kisi mu'ayyan shakhs ke jannati hone ka qat'i ilm kisi ko nahin, na kisi ko aisi baat zaban se kehni chahiye. Bajuz un buzurgon ke jin ke naam le kar Shari' (Alaihis Salam) ne unhein jannati kaha hai jaise Ashra-e-Mubashara aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Salam aur Umaisa aur Bilal aur Suraqa aur Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram jo Hazrat Jabir ke walid hain aur woh sattar qari jo Be'r-e-Ma'una ki jang mein shaheed kiye gaye aur Zaid bin Haritha aur Ja'far aur Ibn-e-Rawaha aur in jaise aur buzurg (Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een). Phir farmata hai Nabi (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum keh do ke main toh sirf us wahi ka muti' hoon jo Allah ki janab se meri janib aaye aur main toh sirf darane wala hoon ke khol khol kar har shakhs ko aagah kar raha hoon, har aqalmand mere mansab se ba-khabar hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ) ka izhar-e-bebasi, mushrikon ki sarkashi aur un ka kufr bayan ho raha hai ke jab unhein Allah ki zahir-o-batin wazeh aur saaf aayatein sunayi jati hain to keh dete hain ke yeh to sarih jadu hai. Takzeeb-o-iftira, zalalat-o-kufr goya un ka shewa ho gaya hai. Jadu keh kar hi bas nahin karte balkay yun bhi kehte hain ke isay to Muhammad (ﷺ) ne ghar liya hai. Pas Nabi ki zabani Allah jawab dilwata hai ke agar main ne hi is Quran ko banaya hai aur main is ka saccha Nabi nahin to yaqeenan woh mujhe mere is jhoot aur bohtan par sakht tar azab kare ga aur phir tum kya saare jahan mein koi aisa nahin jo mujhe us ke azabon se chura sake. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Qul inni lan yujirani minallahi ahadun wa lan ajida min dunihi multahada) (72-Al-Jinn: 22), yani tu keh de ke mujhe Allah ke hath se koi nahin bacha sakta aur na us ke siwa kahin aur mujhe panah ki jagah mil sake gi lekin main Allah ki tabligh aur us ki risalat ko baja lata hoon. Aur jagah hai aayat (Wa law taqawwala alaina ba'dal aqawil) (69-Al-Haqqah: 44), yani agar yeh hum par koi baat bana leta, to hum us ka dahna hath pakar kar us ki rag-e-gardan kaat daalte aur tum mein se koi bhi isay na bacha sakta. Phir kuffar ko dhamkaya ja raha hai ke tumhari guftagu ka pura ilm us Aleem Allah ko hai, wahi mere aur tumhare darmiyan faisla kare ga. Us ki dhamki ke baad unhein tauba aur inabat ki raghbat dilayi ja rahi hai aur farmata hai woh Ghafoor-o-Rahim hai, agar tum us ki taraf ruju karo, apne kartoot se baaz aao to woh bhi tumhein bakhsh de ga aur tum par raham kare ga. Surah Furqan mein bhi isi mazmoon ki aayat hai. Farman hai aayat (Wa qalu asatirul awwaliniktatabaha fahiya tumla alaihi bukrataw wa asila) (25-Al-Furqan: 5), yani yeh kehte hain ke yeh aglon ki kahaniyan hain jo is ne likh li hain aur subh-o-sham likhayi ja rahi hain, to keh de ke isay us Allah ne utara hai jo har posheeda cheez janta hai, khwah aasmanon mein ho khwah zameen mein ho, woh Ghafoor-o-Rahim hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke main duniya mein koi pehla Nabi to nahin. Mujh se pehle bhi to duniya mein logon ki taraf Rasool aate rahe, phir mere aane se tumhein is qadar achambha kyun hua? Mujhe to yeh bhi nahin maloom ke mere sath kya kya jaye ga? Baqol Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is aayat ke baad aayat (Liyaghfira lakallahu ma taqaddama min zambika wa ma ta'akhara wa yutimma ni'matahu alaika wa yahdiyaka siratam mustaqima) (48-Al-Fath: 2), utri hai. Isi tarah Hazrat Ikrama (R.H), Hazrat Hasan (R.H), Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi isay mansookh batate hain. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab aayat-e-bakhshish utri jis mein farmaya gaya taake Allah tere agle pichle gunah bakhshe to ek sahabi ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh to Allah ne bayan farma diya ke woh aap ke sath kya karne wala hai, pas woh hamare sath kya karne wala hai?

Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab aayat-e-bakhshish utri jis mein farmaya gaya taake Allah tere agle pichle gunah bakhshe to ek sahabi ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) yeh to Allah ne bayan farma diya ke woh aap ke sath kya karne wala hai, pas woh hamare sath kya karne wala hai?

Is par aayat (لِّيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّاٰتِهِمْ ۭ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا ۙ) (Surah Al-Fath: 5) utri yani taake Allah momin mardon aur momin aurton ko aisi jannaton mein dakhil kare jin ke neeche nehrein behti hain. Sahih hadith se bhi yeh toh sabit hai ke mominon ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aap ko mubarak ho, farmaiye hamare liye kya hukm hai? Is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari. Hazrat Zahhak (R.A) is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke matlab yeh hai ke mujhe nahin maloom ke main kya hukm diya jaon aur kis cheez se rok diya jaon? Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke is aayat se murad yeh hai ke aakhirat ka anjam toh mujhe qatan maloom hai ke main jannat mein jaunga, haan dunyawi haal maloom nahin ke agle baaz ambiya ki tarah qatl kiya jaon ya apni zindagi ke din poore kar ke Allah ke haan jaon? Aur isi tarah main nahin keh sakta ke tumhein dhansaya jaye ya tum par patthar barsaye jayen. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko motabar kehte hain aur filwaqai hai bhi yeh theek. Aap (ﷺ) bil-yaqeen jante the ke aap aur aap ke pairau jannat mein hi jayenge aur duniya ki halat ke anjam se aap be-khabar the ke anjam-e-kaar aap ka aur aap ke mukhalifeen Quraish ka kya haal hoga? Aaya woh imaan layenge ya kufr par hi rahenge aur azaab kiye jayenge ya bilkul hi halak kar diye jayenge. Lekin jo hadith Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Umm-ul-Ala (R.A) farmati hain jinhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se bai'at ki thi ke jis waqt muhajireen bazariya qura-andazi ansariyon mein taqseem ho rahe the us waqt hamare hisse mein Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) aaye. Aap hamare haan bimar huye aur faut bhi ho gaye. Jab hum aap ko kafan pehna chuke aur Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi tashreef la chuke toh mere munh se nikal gaya, "Aye Abu-us-Saib! Allah tujh par raham kare, meri toh tujh par gawahi hai ke Allah Ta'ala yaqeenan tera ikram hi karega." Is par Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Tumhein kaise maloom ho gaya ke Allah Ta'ala yaqeenan is ka ikram hi karega?" Main ne kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ) par mere maa-baap fida hon, mujhe kuch nahin maloom." Pas aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Suno! Un ke paas toh un ke Rab ki taraf ka yaqeen aa pahuncha aur mujhe in ke liye bhalai aur khair ki umeed hai. Qasam hai Allah ki, bawajood Rasool hone ke main nahin janta ke mere sath kya sulook kiya jayega?" Is par main ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Ab is ke baad main kisi ki barat nahin karungi" aur mujhe is ka bada sadma hua. Lekin main ne khwab mein dekha ke Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) ki ek nahar beh rahi hai. Main ne aakar Huzoor (ﷺ) se is ka zikr kiya toh aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Yeh in ke a'maal hain." Yeh hadith Bukhari mein hai, Muslim mein nahin aur is ki ek sanad mein hai, "Main nahin janta bawajood-e-ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon ke is ke sath kya sulook kiya jayega?"

Dil ko toh kuch aisa lagta hai ke yahi alfaaz mauqa ke lihaz se theek hain kyunke is ke baad hi yeh jumla hai ke mujhe is baat se bada sadma hua. Al-garz yeh hadith aur isi ki hum-ma'ni aur hadithein dalalat hain is amr par ke kisi mu'ayyan shakhs ke jannati hone ka qat'i ilm kisi ko nahin, na kisi ko aisi baat zaban se kehni chahiye. Bajuz un buzurgon ke jin ke naam le kar Shari' (Alaihis Salam) ne unhein jannati kaha hai jaise Ashra-e-Mubashara aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Salam aur Umaisa aur Bilal aur Suraqa aur Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram jo Hazrat Jabir ke walid hain aur woh sattar qari jo Be'r-e-Ma'una ki jang mein shaheed kiye gaye aur Zaid bin Haritha aur Ja'far aur Ibn-e-Rawaha aur in jaise aur buzurg (Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een). Phir farmata hai Nabi (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum keh do ke main toh sirf us wahi ka muti' hoon jo Allah ki janab se meri janib aaye aur main toh sirf darane wala hoon ke khol khol kar har shakhs ko aagah kar raha hoon, har aqalmand mere mansab se ba-khabar hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Walidain se behtareen sulook karo. Is se pehle chunke Allah Ta'ala ki tauheed aur uski ibadat ke ikhlas ka aur us par istiqamat karne ka hukum hua tha, is liye yahan maa baap ke huqooq ki baja awari ka hukum ho raha hai. Isi mazmoon ki aur bahut si aayatein Quran-e-Pak mein majood hain, jaise farmaya aayat (وَقَضٰى رَبُّكَ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْٓا اِلَّآ اِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ اِحْسَانًا ۭ اِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِنْدَكَ الْكِبَرَ اَحَدُهُمَآ اَوْ كِلٰـهُمَا فَلَا تَـقُلْ لَّهُمَآ اُفٍّ وَّلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُلْ لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيْمًا 23؀) (17-Al-Isra: 23) yani tera Rab yeh faisla kar chuka hai ke tum uske siwa kisi aur ki ibadat na karo aur maa baap ke sath ehsan karo. Aur aayat mein hai aayat (ان اشکر لی والوالدیک الی المصیر) mera shukar kar aur apne walidain ka, lautna toh meri hi taraf hai. Aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein hain. Pas yahan irshad hota hai ke hum ne insaan ko hukum kiya hai ke maa baap ke sath ehsan karo, un se tawazo se pesh aao. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hadith hai ke Hazrat Saad ki walida ne aap se kaha ke kya maa baap ki itaat ka hukum Allah ka nahin? Sun, main na khana khaungi na pani piyungi jab tak tu Allah ke sath kufr na kar. Hazrat Saad ke inkar par usne yahi kiya ke khana peena chhod diya, yahan tak ke lakdi se uska munh khol kar jabran pani waghera chhua dete, is par yeh aayat utri. Yeh hadith Muslim Sharif waghera mein bhi hai. Maa ne halat-e-hamal mein kaisi kuch takleefein bardasht ki hain? Isi tarah bacha hone ke waqt kaisi kaisi museebaton ka woh shikar bani hai? Hazrat Ali (Karam Allahu Wajhahu) ne is aayat se aur iske sath Surah Luqman ki aayat (وَّفِصٰلُهٗ فِيْ عَامَيْنِ اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ ۭ اِلَيَّ الْمَصِيْرُ 14؀) (31-Luqman: 14) aur Allah Azzawajal ka farman aayat (وَالْوَالِدٰتُ يُرْضِعْنَ اَوْلَادَھُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ لِمَنْ اَرَادَ اَنْ يُّـتِمَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ) (2-Al-Baqarah: 233) yani maayein apne bachon ko do saal kamil doodh pilayein unke liye jo doodh pilane ki muddat poori karna chahein, mila kar istidlal kiya hai ke hamal ki kam se kam muddat chhe maah hai. Yeh istidlal bahut qawi aur bilkul sahi hai. Hazrat Usman (R.A) aur Sahaba-e-Kiram ki jamaat ne bhi iski tayeed ki hai. Hazrat Muammar bin Abdullah Jahni farmate hain ke hamare qabeelay ke ek shakhs ne Jahniya ki ek aurat se nikah kiya, chhe mahine poore hote hi use bacha tawallud hua. Uske khawand ne Hazrat Usman (R.A) se zikr kiya, aap ne us aurat ke paas aadmi bheja. Woh tayyar ho kar aane lagi toh unki behan ne girya-o-zari shuru kar di. Is biwi sahiba ne apni behan ko taskeen di aur farmaya kyun roti ho? Allah ki qasam, iski makhlooq mein se kisi se main nahin mili, main ne kabhi koi bura fe'l nahin kiya, toh dekho ke Allah ka faisla mere bare mein kya hota hai. Jab Hazrat Usman (R.A) ke paas yeh aayin toh aap ne unhein rajam karne ka hukum diya.

Jab Hazrat Ali R.A ko yeh baat maloom hui toh aap ne Khalifatul Muslimeen se daryaft kiya ke yeh aap kya kar rahe hain? Aap ne jawab diya ke is aurat ko nikah ke chhe mahine ke baad bacha hua hai jo namumkin hai. Yeh sun kar Ali Murtaza R.A ne farmaya kya aap ne Quran nahin padha? Farmaya haan padha hai, farmaya kya yeh aayat nahin padhi (Wa hamluhu wa fisaluhu thalathuna shahra) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 15) aur saath hi yeh aayat bhi (Haulaini kamilaini) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 233). Pas muddat-e-haml aur muddat-e-doodh pilai dono ke mil kar tees mahine aur is mein se jab doodh pilai ki kul muddat do saal ke chaubees (mahine) waza kar diye jayen toh baqi chhe mahine reh jate hain, toh Quran-e-Kareem se maloom hua ke haml ki kam az kam muddat chhe mah hai aur is biwi sahiba ko bhi itni hi muddat mein bacha hua hai, phir is par zina ka ilzaam kaise qaim kar rahe hain? Hazrat Usman R.A ne farmaya Wallah yeh baat bahut theek hai, afsos mera khayal hai main is taraf nahin gaya, jao is aurat ko le aao. Pas logon ne is aurat ko is haal par paya ke use faraghat ho chuki thi. Hazrat Muammar R.H farmate hain Wallah ek kawa dusre kawe se aur ek anda dusre ande se bhi itna mushaba nahin hota jitna is aurat ka yeh bacha apne baap se mushaba tha. Khud is ke walid ne bhi ise dekh kar kaha Allah ki qasam is bache ke bare mein mujhe ab koi shak nahin raha aur ise Allah Ta'ala ne ek nasoor ke saath mubtala kiya jo is ke chehre par tha, woh hi ise ghulata raha yahan tak ke woh mar gaya (Ibn Abi Hatim). Yeh riwayat dusri sanad se aayat (Fa ana awwalul abideen) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 81) ki tafsir mein hum ne warid ki hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jab kisi aurat ko nau mahine mein bacha ho toh is ki doodh pilai ki muddat ikees mah kafi hain aur jab saat mahine mein ho toh muddat-e-raza'at taees mah aur jab chhe mah mein bacha ho jaye toh muddat-e-raza'at do saal kamil, is liye ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka farman hai ke haml aur doodh chhudane ki muddat tees mahine hai. Jab woh apni puri quwwat ke zamane ko pahuncha yani qawi ho gaya, jawani ki umar mein pahunch gaya, mardon mein jo halat hoti hai umuman phir baqi umar wahi halat rehti hai. Hazrat Masroq R.H se pucha gaya ke insaan ab apne gunahon par pakda jata hai? Toh farmaya jab tu chalees saal ka ho jaye toh apne bachao muhayya kar le. Abu Ya'la Mosli mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab musalman banda chalees saal ka ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala is ke hisab mein takhfeef kar deta hai aur jab saath saal ka ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala ise apni taraf jhukna naseeb farmata hai aur jab sattar saal ki umar ka ho jata hai toh aasman wale is se mohabbat karne lagte hain aur jab assi saal ka ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala is ki nekiyan sabit rakhta hai aur is ki buraiyan mita deta hai aur jab nawwe saal ka hota hai toh Allah Ta'ala is ke agle pichhle gunah maaf farmata hai aur is ke gharane ke admiyon ke bare mein ise shafa'at karne wala banata hai.

Aur aasmanon mein likh diya jata hai ke yeh Allah ki zameen mein us ka qaidi hai. Yeh hadith dusri sanad se Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai. Banu Umayya ke Damishqi governor Hajjaj bin Abdullah Halimi farmate hain ke chalees saal ki umar mein toh main ne nafarmaniyon aur gunahon ko logon ki sharm-o-haya se chhora tha, is ke baad gunahon ke chhorne ka ba'is khud zaat-e-Allah se haya thi. Arab shayar kehta hai bachpane mein nasamjhi ki halat mein toh jo kuch ho gaya ho gaya lekin jis waqt burhape ne munh dikhaya toh sar ki safedi ne khud hi buraiyon se keh diya ke ab tum kuch kar jao. Phir us ki dua ka bayan ho raha hai ke us ne kaha mere Parwardigar mere dil mein daal ke teri ne'mat ka shukr karoon jo tu ne mujh par aur mere maa baap par in'am farmayi aur main woh a'maal karoon jin se tu mustaqbil mein khush ho jaye aur meri aulad mein mere liye islah kar de yani meri nasl aur mere peeche walon mein. Main teri taraf ruju karta hoon aur mera iqrar hai ke main farmabardaron mein hoon. Is mein irshad hai ke chalees saal ki umar ko pahunch kar insaan ko pukhta dil se Allah ki taraf tauba karni chahiye aur naye sire se Allah ki taraf ruju-o-raghbat kar ke us par jam jana chahiye. Abu Dawood mein hai ke Sahaba ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) At-Tahiyat mein parhne ke liye is dua ki ta'leem kiya karte the, dua: (Allahumma allif baina qulubina wa aslih zata bainina wahdina subulas-salami wa najjina minaz-zulumati ilan-nuri wa jannibnal-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa ma batana wa barik lana fi asma'ina wa absarina wa qulubina wa azwajina wa dhurriyatina wa tub 'alaina innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim, waj'alna shakirina li-ni'matika muth-nina biha 'alaika qabiliha wa atimmaha 'alaina). Yani ae Allah hamare dilon mein ulfat daal aur hamare aapas mein islah kar de aur hamein salamti ki raahein dikha aur hamein andheron se bacha kar noor ki taraf nijat de aur hamein har burai se bacha le khwah woh zahir ho khwah chhupi hui ho aur hamein hamare kanon mein aur aankhon mein aur dilon mein aur biwi bachon mein barkat de aur hum par ruju farma yaqeenan tu ruju farmane wala meharban hai. Ae Allah hamein apni ne'maton ka shukr guzar aur un ke ba'is apna sana khwan aur ne'maton ka iqrari bana aur apni bharpoor ne'maten hamein ata farma. Phir farmata hai yeh jin ka bayan guzra jo Allah ki taraf tauba karne wale us ki janib mein jhukne wale aur jo nekiyan chhoot jayen unhein kasrat-e-istighfar se pa lene wale hi woh hain jin ki aksar laghzishein hum maaf farma dete hain aur un ke thore nek a'maal ke badle hum unhein Jannati bana dete hain. Un ka yahi hukm hai jaise ke wa'da kiya aur farmaya yeh woh sacha wa'da hai jo un se wa'da kiya jata tha. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ba-riwayat-e-Rooh-ul-Amin (Alaihis Salam) farmate hain insaan ki nekiyan aur badiyan layi jayengi. Aur ek ko ek ke badle mein kiya jayega pas agar ek neki bhi bach rahi toh Allah Ta'ala usi ke ewaz use Jannat mein pahuncha dega. Rawi-e-hadith ne apne ustad se poocha agar tamam nekiyan hi buraiyon ke badle mein chali jayen toh?

Aap ne farmaya un ki buraiyon se Allah Rabbul Izzat tajawuz farma leta hai, dusri sanad mein yeh ba-farman-e-Allah Azzawajal marwi hai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad bahut pukhta hai. Hazrat Yusuf bin Sa'ad farmate hain ke jab Hazrat Ali R.A ke paas tha aur us waqt Hazrat Ammar, Hazrat Sa'isa'a, Hazrat Ashtar, Hazrat Muhammad bin Abu Bakr R.A bhi thay. Ba'az logon ne Hazrat Usman R.A ka zikr nikala aur kuch gustakhi ki. Hazrat Ali R.A us waqt takht par baithay huay thay, haath mein chhari thi. Hazireen-e-majlis mein se kisi ne kaha ke aap ke samne to aap ki is behas ka sahih muhakma karne wale majood hi hain, chunancha sab logon ne Hazrat Ali R.A se sawal kiya. Is par aap ne farmaya Hazrat Usman R.A un logon mein se thay jin ke bare mein Allah Azzawajal farmata hai, aayat: (Ula'ika alladhina nataqabbalu 'anhum ahsana ma 'amilu wa natajawazu 'an sayyi'atihim fi as-habi al-jannati wa'da as-sidqi alladhi kanu yu'adun) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 16), qasam Allah ki yeh log jin ka zikr is aayat mein hai Hazrat Usman R.A hain aur un ke saathi, teen martaba yahi farmaya. Rawi Yusuf kehte hain main ne Muhammad bin Hatib se pucha sach kaho tumhein Allah ki qasam tum ne khud Hazrat Ali R.A ki zabani yeh suna hai? Farmaya haan qasam Allah ki main ne khud Hazrat Ali R.A se yeh suna hai.

Farmaya haan padha hai, farmaya kya yeh aayat nahin padhi (Wa hamluhu wa fisaluhu thalathuna shahra) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 15) aur saath hi yeh aayat bhi (Haulaini kamilaini) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 233). Pas muddat-e-haml aur muddat-e-doodh pilai dono ke mil kar tees mahine aur is mein se jab doodh pilai ki kul muddat do saal ke chaubees (mahine) waza kar diye jayen toh baqi chhe mahine reh jate hain, toh Quran-e-Kareem se maloom hua ke haml ki kam az kam muddat chhe mah hai aur is biwi sahiba ko bhi itni hi muddat mein bacha hua hai, phir is par zina ka ilzaam kaise qaim kar rahe hain? Hazrat Usman R.A ne farmaya Wallah yeh baat bahut theek hai, afsos mera khayal hai main is taraf nahin gaya, jao is aurat ko le aao. Pas logon ne is aurat ko is haal par paya ke use faraghat ho chuki thi. Hazrat Muammar R.H farmate hain Wallah ek kawa dusre kawe se aur ek anda dusre ande se bhi itna mushaba nahin hota jitna is aurat ka yeh bacha apne baap se mushaba tha. Khud is ke walid ne bhi ise dekh kar kaha Allah ki qasam is bache ke bare mein mujhe ab koi shak nahin raha aur ise Allah Ta'ala ne ek nasoor ke saath mubtala kiya jo is ke chehre par tha, woh hi ise ghulata raha yahan tak ke woh mar gaya (Ibn Abi Hatim). Yeh riwayat dusri sanad se aayat (Fa ana awwalul abideen) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 81) ki tafsir mein hum ne warid ki hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jab kisi aurat ko nau mahine mein bacha ho toh is ki doodh pilai ki muddat ikees mah kafi hain aur jab saat mahine mein ho toh muddat-e-raza'at taees mah aur jab chhe mah mein bacha ho jaye toh muddat-e-raza'at do saal kamil, is liye ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka farman hai ke haml aur doodh chhudane ki muddat tees mahine hai. Jab woh apni puri quwwat ke zamane ko pahuncha yani qawi ho gaya, jawani ki umar mein pahunch gaya, mardon mein jo halat hoti hai umuman phir baqi umar wahi halat rehti hai. Hazrat Masroq R.H se pucha gaya ke insaan ab apne gunahon par pakda jata hai? Toh farmaya jab tu chalees saal ka ho jaye toh apne bachao muhayya kar le. Abu Ya'la Mosli mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab musalman banda chalees saal ka ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala is ke hisab mein takhfeef kar deta hai aur jab saath saal ka ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala ise apni taraf jhukna naseeb farmata hai aur jab sattar saal ki umar ka ho jata hai toh aasman wale is se mohabbat karne lagte hain aur jab assi saal ka ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala is ki nekiyan sabit rakhta hai aur is ki buraiyan mita deta hai aur jab nawwe saal ka hota hai toh Allah Ta'ala is ke agle pichhle gunah maaf farmata hai aur is ke gharane ke admiyon ke bare mein ise shafa'at karne wala banata hai.

Aur aasmanon mein likh diya jata hai ke yeh Allah ki zameen mein us ka qaidi hai. Yeh hadith dusri sanad se Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai. Banu Umayya ke Damishqi governor Hajjaj bin Abdullah Halimi farmate hain ke chalees saal ki umar mein toh main ne nafarmaniyon aur gunahon ko logon ki sharm-o-haya se chhora tha, is ke baad gunahon ke chhorne ka ba'is khud zaat-e-Allah se haya thi. Arab shayar kehta hai bachpane mein nasamjhi ki halat mein toh jo kuch ho gaya ho gaya lekin jis waqt burhape ne munh dikhaya toh sar ki safedi ne khud hi buraiyon se keh diya ke ab tum kuch kar jao. Phir us ki dua ka bayan ho raha hai ke us ne kaha mere Parwardigar mere dil mein daal ke teri ne'mat ka shukr karoon jo tu ne mujh par aur mere maa baap par in'am farmayi aur main woh a'maal karoon jin se tu mustaqbil mein khush ho jaye aur meri aulad mein mere liye islah kar de yani meri nasl aur mere peeche walon mein. Main teri taraf ruju karta hoon aur mera iqrar hai ke main farmabardaron mein hoon. Is mein irshad hai ke chalees saal ki umar ko pahunch kar insaan ko pukhta dil se Allah ki taraf tauba karni chahiye aur naye sire se Allah ki taraf ruju-o-raghbat kar ke us par jam jana chahiye. Abu Dawood mein hai ke Sahaba ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) At-Tahiyat mein parhne ke liye is dua ki ta'leem kiya karte the, dua: (Allahumma allif baina qulubina wa aslih zata bainina wahdina subulas-salami wa najjina minaz-zulumati ilan-nuri wa jannibnal-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa ma batana wa barik lana fi asma'ina wa absarina wa qulubina wa azwajina wa dhurriyatina wa tub 'alaina innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim, waj'alna shakirina li-ni'matika muth-nina biha 'alaika qabiliha wa atimmaha 'alaina). Yani ae Allah hamare dilon mein ulfat daal aur hamare aapas mein islah kar de aur hamein salamti ki raahein dikha aur hamein andheron se bacha kar noor ki taraf nijat de aur hamein har burai se bacha le khwah woh zahir ho khwah chhupi hui ho aur hamein hamare kanon mein aur aankhon mein aur dilon mein aur biwi bachon mein barkat de aur hum par ruju farma yaqeenan tu ruju farmane wala meharban hai. Ae Allah hamein apni ne'maton ka shukr guzar aur un ke ba'is apna sana khwan aur ne'maton ka iqrari bana aur apni bharpoor ne'maten hamein ata farma. Phir farmata hai yeh jin ka bayan guzra jo Allah ki taraf tauba karne wale us ki janib mein jhukne wale aur jo nekiyan chhoot jayen unhein kasrat-e-istighfar se pa lene wale hi woh hain jin ki aksar laghzishein hum maaf farma dete hain aur un ke thore nek a'maal ke badle hum unhein Jannati bana dete hain. Un ka yahi hukm hai jaise ke wa'da kiya aur farmaya yeh woh sacha wa'da hai jo un se wa'da kiya jata tha. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ba-riwayat-e-Rooh-ul-Amin (Alaihis Salam) farmate hain insaan ki nekiyan aur badiyan layi jayengi. Aur ek ko ek ke badle mein kiya jayega pas agar ek neki bhi bach rahi toh Allah Ta'ala usi ke ewaz use Jannat mein pahuncha dega. Rawi-e-hadith ne apne ustad se poocha agar tamam nekiyan hi buraiyon ke badle mein chali jayen toh?

Aap ne farmaya un ki buraiyon se Allah Rabbul Izzat tajawuz farma leta hai, dusri sanad mein yeh ba-farman-e-Allah Azzawajal marwi hai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad bahut pukhta hai. Hazrat Yusuf bin Sa'ad farmate hain ke jab Hazrat Ali R.A ke paas tha aur us waqt Hazrat Ammar, Hazrat Sa'isa'a, Hazrat Ashtar, Hazrat Muhammad bin Abu Bakr R.A bhi thay. Ba'az logon ne Hazrat Usman R.A ka zikr nikala aur kuch gustakhi ki. Hazrat Ali R.A us waqt takht par baithay huay thay, haath mein chhari thi. Hazireen-e-majlis mein se kisi ne kaha ke aap ke samne to aap ki is behas ka sahih muhakma karne wale majood hi hain, chunancha sab logon ne Hazrat Ali R.A se sawal kiya. Is par aap ne farmaya Hazrat Usman R.A un logon mein se thay jin ke bare mein Allah Azzawajal farmata hai, aayat: (Ula'ika alladhina nataqabbalu 'anhum ahsana ma 'amilu wa natajawazu 'an sayyi'atihim fi as-habi al-jannati wa'da as-sidqi alladhi kanu yu'adun) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 16), qasam Allah ki yeh log jin ka zikr is aayat mein hai Hazrat Usman R.A hain aur un ke saathi, teen martaba yahi farmaya. Rawi Yusuf kehte hain main ne Muhammad bin Hatib se pucha sach kaho tumhein Allah ki qasam tum ne khud Hazrat Ali R.A ki zabani yeh suna hai? Farmaya haan qasam Allah ki main ne khud Hazrat Ali R.A se yeh suna hai.

Is dunya ke talib akhirat se mehroom honge chunke oopar un logon ka haal bayan hua tha jo apne maa baap ke haq mein nek duayein karte hain aur unki khidmatein karte rehte hain aur saath hi unke ukhrawi darjaat ka aur wahan nijaat paane aur apne Rab ki naimaton se maal-o-maal hone ka zikr hua tha. Is liye iske baad un badbakhton ka bayan ho raha hai jo apne maa baap ke nafarman hain unhein baatein sunate hain. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ke sahibzade Hazrat Abdur Rahman ke haq mein nazil hui hai jaise ke Aufi barwayat Ibn Abbas bayan karte hain jis ki sehat mein bhi kalaam hai aur jo qaul nihayat kamzor hai is liye ke Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr to musalman ho gaye the aur bahut achhe Islam walon mein se the balkeh apne zamane ke behtareen logon mein se the. Baaz aur mufassireen ka bhi yeh qaul hai lekin theek yahi hai ke yeh aayat aam hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Marwan ne apne khutba mein kaha ke Allah Ta'ala ne Ameer-ul-Momineen ko Yazid ke bare mein ek achhi raye samjhai hai agar woh unhein apne baad bator-e-khalifa ke namzad kar jayein to Hazrat Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Umar ne bhi to apne baad khalifa muqarrar kiya hai. Is par Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr bol uthe ke kya Heraclius ke dastoor par aur Nasraniyon ke qanoon par amal karna chahte ho? Qasam hai Allah ki na to Khalifa-e-Awwal ne apni aulad mein se kisi ko khilafat ke liye muntakhab kiya na apne kunbe qabile walon se kisi ko namzad kiya aur Muawiyah ne jo ise kiya woh sirf unki izzat afzai aur unke bachon par raham kha kar kiya. Yeh sun kar Marwan kehne laga ke tu wahi nahin jis ne apne walidain ko 'Uff' kaha tha? To Abdur Rahman ne farmaya kya tu ek maloon shakhs ki aulad mein se nahin? Tere baap par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne laanat ki thi. Hazrat Siddiqa R.A ne yeh sun kar Marwan se kaha tu ne Hazrat Abdur Rahman se jo kaha woh bilkul jhoot hai woh aayat unke bare mein nahin balkeh woh falan bin falan ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Phir Marwan jaldi hi mimbar se utar kar aap ke hujre ke darwaze par aaya aur kuch baatein kar ke laut gaya. Bukhari mein yeh hadith dusri sanad se aur alfaaz ke saath hai. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan ki taraf se Marwan Hijaz ka ameer banaya gaya tha. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Marwan ne Hazrat Abdur Rahman ko giraftar kar lene ka hukum apne sipahiyon ko diya lekin yeh daud kar apni hamshira sahiba Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha R.A ke hujre mein chale gaye is wajah se unhein koi pakad na saka. Aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Siddiqa Kubra R.A ne parda mein se hi farmaya ke hamare bare mein bajuz meri paak damni ki aayaton ke aur koi aayat nahin utri.

Nasa'i ki riwayat mein hai ke is khutbay se maqsood Yazid ki taraf se bai'at hasil karna tha. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke farman mein yeh bhi hai ke Marwan apne qaul mein jhoota hai, jis ke baray mein yeh aayat utri hai. Mujhe bakhoobi maloom hai lekin main is waqt usay zahir karna nahin chahti, lekin haan Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Marwan ke baap ko mal'oon kaha hai aur Marwan us ki pusht mein tha, pas yeh us Allah Ta'ala ki la'nat ka baqiya hai. Yeh jahan apne maa baap ki be-adabi karta hai wahan Allah Ta'ala ki be-adabi se bhi nahin chookta. Marne ke baad ki zindagi ko jhutlata hai aur apne maa baap se kehta hai ke tum mujhe is doosri zindagi se kya daratay ho? Mujh se pehle saikron zamanay guzar gaye, lakhon karoron insaan maray, main ne to kisi ko dobara zinda hotay nahin dekha, un mein se ek bhi to laut kar khabar denay nahin aaya. Maa baap becharay us se tang aa kar Janab-e-Bari se us ki hidayat chahtay hain, us bargah mein apni faryad pohanchatay hain aur phir us se kehtay hain ke badnaseeb abhi kuch nahin bigra, ab bhi Musalman ban ja. Lekin yeh maghroor phir jawab deta hai ke jisay tum mannay ko kehtay ho main to usay ek derina qissa se zyada waqat ki nazar se nahin dekh sakta. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh log apne jaisay guzashta jinnat aur insanon ke zumray mein dakhil ho gaye jinhon ne khud apna nuqsan bhi kiya aur apne walon ko bhi barbad kiya. Allah Ta'ala ke farman mein yahan lafz (Ula'ika) hai halankeh us se pehle lafz (Wallazi) hai, is se bhi hamari tafseer ki poori ta'eed hoti hai ke murad is se aam hai, jo bhi aisa ho yani maa baap ka be-adab aur Qayamat ka munkir, us ke liye yahi hukm hai. Chunancha Hazrat Hasan (R.H) aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi yahi farmatay hain ke is se murad kafir, fajir, maa baap ka nafarman aur mar kar jee uthnay ka munkir hai. Ibn-e-Asakir ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai ke chaar shakhson par Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apne Arsh par se la'nat ki hai aur us par farishton ne aameen kahi hai: Jo kisi maskeen ko behkaye aur kahay ke aao tujhay kuch doon ga aur jab woh aaye to keh day ke mere paas to kuch nahin, aur jo ma'oon se kahay sab hazir hai halankeh us ke aagay kuch na ho, aur woh log jo kisi ko us ke is sawal ke jawab mein ke "falan ka makan kaunsa hai?" kisi doosray ka makan bata dein, aur woh jo apne maa baap ko maaray yahan tak ke tang aa jayen aur cheekh-o-pukar karne lagen. Phir farmata hai har ek ke liye us ki burai ke mutabiq saza hai. Allah Ta'ala ek zarray ke barabar balkeh us se bhi kam kisi par zulm nahin karta. Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmatay hain Jahannam ke darjay neechay hain aur Jannat ke darjay oonchay hain.

Phir farmata hai ke jab jahannami jahannam par la kharay kiye jayenge unhein bator daant-dupat ke kaha jayega ke tum apni nekiyan duniya mein hi wasool kar chuke un se faida wahin utha liya, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne bahut zyada marghoob aur lateef ghiza se isi aayat ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar ijtinab kar liya tha aur farmate thay mujhe khauf hai kahin main bhi un logon mein se na ho jaon jinhein Allah Ta'ala daant-dupat ke sath yeh farmayega. Hazrat Abu Jafar (R.H) farmate hain ke baaz log aise bhi hain jo duniya mein ki hui apni nekiyan Qayamat ke din gum payenge aur un se yahi kaha jayega. Phir farmata hai aaj unhein zillat ke azabon ki saza di jayegi un ke takabbur aur un ke fisq ki wajah se jaisa amal waisa hi badla mila. Duniya mein yeh naaz-o-nemat se apni jaanon ko paalne wale aur nakhawat-o-badai se itteba-e-haq ko chhorne wale aur buraiyon aur nafarmaniyon mein hama-tan mashghool rehne wale thay to aaj Qayamat ke din unhein ihanat aur ruswai wale azab aur sakht dardnak sazayein aur haye-waye aur afsos-o-hasrat ke sath jahannam ke neeche ke tabqon mein jagah milegi Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala hamein un sab baaton se mehfooz rakhe.

Duniya mein yeh naaz-o-nemat se apni jaanon ko paalne wale aur nakhawat-o-badai se itteba-e-haq ko chhorne wale aur buraiyon aur nafarmaniyon mein hama-tan mashghool rehne wale thay to aaj Qayamat ke din unhein ihanat aur ruswai wale azab aur sakht dardnak sazayein aur haye-waye aur afsos-o-hasrat ke sath jahannam ke neeche ke tabqon mein jagah milegi Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala hamein un sab baaton se mehfooz rakhe.

Is dunya ke talib akhirat se mehroom honge chunke oopar un logon ka haal bayan hua tha jo apne maa baap ke haq mein nek duayein karte hain aur unki khidmatein karte rehte hain aur saath hi unke ukhrawi darjaat ka aur wahan nijaat paane aur apne Rab ki naimaton se maal-o-maal hone ka zikr hua tha. Is liye iske baad un badbakhton ka bayan ho raha hai jo apne maa baap ke nafarman hain unhein baatein sunate hain. Baaz log kehte hain ke yeh aayat Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ke sahibzade Hazrat Abdur Rahman ke haq mein nazil hui hai jaise ke Aufi barwayat Ibn Abbas bayan karte hain jis ki sehat mein bhi kalaam hai aur jo qaul nihayat kamzor hai is liye ke Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr to musalman ho gaye the aur bahut achhe Islam walon mein se the balkeh apne zamane ke behtareen logon mein se the. Baaz aur mufassireen ka bhi yeh qaul hai lekin theek yahi hai ke yeh aayat aam hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Marwan ne apne khutba mein kaha ke Allah Ta'ala ne Ameer-ul-Momineen ko Yazid ke bare mein ek achhi raye samjhai hai agar woh unhein apne baad bator-e-khalifa ke namzad kar jayein to Hazrat Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Umar ne bhi to apne baad khalifa muqarrar kiya hai. Is par Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr bol uthe ke kya Heraclius ke dastoor par aur Nasraniyon ke qanoon par amal karna chahte ho? Qasam hai Allah ki na to Khalifa-e-Awwal ne apni aulad mein se kisi ko khilafat ke liye muntakhab kiya na apne kunbe qabile walon se kisi ko namzad kiya aur Muawiyah ne jo ise kiya woh sirf unki izzat afzai aur unke bachon par raham kha kar kiya. Yeh sun kar Marwan kehne laga ke tu wahi nahin jis ne apne walidain ko 'Uff' kaha tha? To Abdur Rahman ne farmaya kya tu ek maloon shakhs ki aulad mein se nahin? Tere baap par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne laanat ki thi. Hazrat Siddiqa R.A ne yeh sun kar Marwan se kaha tu ne Hazrat Abdur Rahman se jo kaha woh bilkul jhoot hai woh aayat unke bare mein nahin balkeh woh falan bin falan ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Phir Marwan jaldi hi mimbar se utar kar aap ke hujre ke darwaze par aaya aur kuch baatein kar ke laut gaya. Bukhari mein yeh hadith dusri sanad se aur alfaaz ke saath hai. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan ki taraf se Marwan Hijaz ka ameer banaya gaya tha. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Marwan ne Hazrat Abdur Rahman ko giraftar kar lene ka hukum apne sipahiyon ko diya lekin yeh daud kar apni hamshira sahiba Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha R.A ke hujre mein chale gaye is wajah se unhein koi pakad na saka. Aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Siddiqa Kubra R.A ne parda mein se hi farmaya ke hamare bare mein bajuz meri paak damni ki aayaton ke aur koi aayat nahin utri.

Nasa'i ki riwayat mein hai ke is khutbay se maqsood Yazid ki taraf se bai'at hasil karna tha. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke farman mein yeh bhi hai ke Marwan apne qaul mein jhoota hai, jis ke baray mein yeh aayat utri hai. Mujhe bakhoobi maloom hai lekin main is waqt usay zahir karna nahin chahti, lekin haan Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Marwan ke baap ko mal'oon kaha hai aur Marwan us ki pusht mein tha, pas yeh us Allah Ta'ala ki la'nat ka baqiya hai. Yeh jahan apne maa baap ki be-adabi karta hai wahan Allah Ta'ala ki be-adabi se bhi nahin chookta. Marne ke baad ki zindagi ko jhutlata hai aur apne maa baap se kehta hai ke tum mujhe is doosri zindagi se kya daratay ho? Mujh se pehle saikron zamanay guzar gaye, lakhon karoron insaan maray, main ne to kisi ko dobara zinda hotay nahin dekha, un mein se ek bhi to laut kar khabar denay nahin aaya. Maa baap becharay us se tang aa kar Janab-e-Bari se us ki hidayat chahtay hain, us bargah mein apni faryad pohanchatay hain aur phir us se kehtay hain ke badnaseeb abhi kuch nahin bigra, ab bhi Musalman ban ja. Lekin yeh maghroor phir jawab deta hai ke jisay tum mannay ko kehtay ho main to usay ek derina qissa se zyada waqat ki nazar se nahin dekh sakta. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh log apne jaisay guzashta jinnat aur insanon ke zumray mein dakhil ho gaye jinhon ne khud apna nuqsan bhi kiya aur apne walon ko bhi barbad kiya. Allah Ta'ala ke farman mein yahan lafz (Ula'ika) hai halankeh us se pehle lafz (Wallazi) hai, is se bhi hamari tafseer ki poori ta'eed hoti hai ke murad is se aam hai, jo bhi aisa ho yani maa baap ka be-adab aur Qayamat ka munkir, us ke liye yahi hukm hai. Chunancha Hazrat Hasan (R.H) aur Hazrat Qatada (R.H) bhi yahi farmatay hain ke is se murad kafir, fajir, maa baap ka nafarman aur mar kar jee uthnay ka munkir hai. Ibn-e-Asakir ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai ke chaar shakhson par Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apne Arsh par se la'nat ki hai aur us par farishton ne aameen kahi hai: Jo kisi maskeen ko behkaye aur kahay ke aao tujhay kuch doon ga aur jab woh aaye to keh day ke mere paas to kuch nahin, aur jo ma'oon se kahay sab hazir hai halankeh us ke aagay kuch na ho, aur woh log jo kisi ko us ke is sawal ke jawab mein ke "falan ka makan kaunsa hai?" kisi doosray ka makan bata dein, aur woh jo apne maa baap ko maaray yahan tak ke tang aa jayen aur cheekh-o-pukar karne lagen. Phir farmata hai har ek ke liye us ki burai ke mutabiq saza hai. Allah Ta'ala ek zarray ke barabar balkeh us se bhi kam kisi par zulm nahin karta. Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmatay hain Jahannam ke darjay neechay hain aur Jannat ke darjay oonchay hain.

Phir farmata hai ke jab jahannami jahannam par la kharay kiye jayenge unhein bator daant-dupat ke kaha jayega ke tum apni nekiyan duniya mein hi wasool kar chuke un se faida wahin utha liya, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne bahut zyada marghoob aur lateef ghiza se isi aayat ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar ijtinab kar liya tha aur farmate thay mujhe khauf hai kahin main bhi un logon mein se na ho jaon jinhein Allah Ta'ala daant-dupat ke sath yeh farmayega. Qaum-e-Aad ki tabahi ke asbab. Janab-e-Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasalli ke liye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke agar aap ki qaum aap ko jhutlaye toh aap aglay ambiya ke waqiyat yaad kar lijiye ke un ki qaum ne bhi un ki takzeeb ki. Aadiyon ke bhai se murad Hazrat Hud Paighambar (A.S / Alaihis Salam) hain. Unhein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne Aad-e-Ula ki taraf bheja tha jo Ahqaf mein rehte thay. Ahqaf jama hai Haqf ki aur Haqf kehte hain ret ke pahar ko. Mutlaq pahar aur ghar aur Hadhramaut ki wadi jis ka naam Barhut hai jahan kuffar ki roohein dali jati hain, yeh matlab bhi Ahqaf ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Qatada ka qaul hai ke Yaman mein samundar ke kinare ret ke telon mein ek jagah thi jis ka naam Shahr tha, yahan yeh log abad thay. Imam Ibn-e-Majah ne baab bandha hai ke jab dua mange toh apne nafs se shuru kare, is mein ek hadith laye hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala hum par aur Aadiyon ke bhai par raham kare. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Azza-o-Jal ne un ke ird-gird ke shahron mein bhi apne Rasool mab'oos farmaye thay. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (فَجَــعَلْنٰھَا نَكَالًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ 66) (2. Al-Baqarah: 66) aur jaise Allah Jalla-o-Ala ka farman hai ayat (فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَقُلْ اَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ 13ۭ) (41. Fussilat: 13), phir farmata hai ke Hazrat Hud (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne apni qaum se farmaya ke tum muwahhid ban jao warna tumhein is baray bhari din mein azab hoga. Jis par qaum ne kaha kya tu hamein hamaray maboodon se rok raha hai? Ja jis azab se tu hamein dara raha hai woh le aa. Yeh toh apne zehan mein isay muhaal jantay thay toh jurrat kar ke jald talab kiya. Jaise ke aur ayat mein hai ayat (يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهَا 18؀) (42. Ash-Shura: 18) yani iman na lanay walay hamaray azabon ke jald aanay ki khwahish kartay hain. Is ke jawab mein un ke paighambar ne kaha ke Allah hi ko behtar ilm hai agar woh tumhein isi laiq janay ga toh tum par azab bhej de ga. Mera mansab toh sirf itna hi hai ke main apne Rabb ki risalat tumhein pahuncha doon lekin main janta hoon ke tum bilkul be-aql aur bewaqoof log ho. Ab Allah ka azab aa gaya, unhon ne dekha ke ek kala abr un ki taraf barhta chala aa raha hai. Chunke khushk-sali thi, garmi sakht thi, yeh khushiyan mananay lagay ke acha hua abr charha hai aur isi taraf rukh hai ab barish barse gi. Dar-asal abr ki soorat mein yeh woh qahr-e-Ilahi tha jis ke aanay ki woh jaldi macha rahay thay. Is mein woh azab tha jisay Hazrat Hud (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se yeh talab kar rahay thay. Woh azab un ki bastiyon ki tamam un cheezon ko bhi jin ki barbadi honay wali thi tahas-nahas karta hua aaya aur isi ka isay Allah ka hukum tha jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيْمِ 42؀ۭ) (51. Adh-Dhariyat: 42) yani jis cheez par woh guzar jati thi usay choora choora kar deti thi.

Pas sab ke sab halak-o-tabah ho gaye, ek bhi na bach saka. Phir farmata hai hum isi tarah un ka faisla karte hain jo hamare Rasoolon ko jhutlayein aur hamare ahkaam ki khilaf warzi karein. Ek bahut hi ghareeb hadith mein un ka jo qissa aaya hai woh bhi sun lijiye. Hazrat Haris (R.A) kehte hain main Ala bin Hazrami ki shikayat le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein ja raha tha. Rabzah mein mujhe Banu Tamim ki ek burhiya mili jis ke paas sawari waghera na thi, mujh se kehne lagi, "Ae Allah ke bande! Mera ek kaam Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se hai, kya tu mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ) tak pahuncha de ga?" Main ne iqrar kiya aur unhein apni sawari par bitha liya aur Madina Sharif pahuncha. Main ne dekha ke Masjid-e-Sharif logon se khacha-khach bhari hui hai, siyah rang jhanda lehra raha hai aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) talwar latkaye Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne khade hain. Main ne daryaft kiya ke kya baat hai? To logon ne mujh se kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ) Amr bin Aas (R.A) ko kisi taraf bhejna chahte hain." Main ek taraf baith gaya, jab An-Huzoor (ﷺ) apni manzil ya apne khaime mein tashreef le gaye to main bhi gaya, ijazat talab ki aur ijazat milne par aap ki khidmat mein baryab hua. Salam kiya to aap ne mujh se daryaft farmaya ke kya tumhare aur Banu Tamim ke darmiyan kuch ranjish thi? Main ne kaha, "Haan aur hum un par ghalib rahe the aur ab mere is safar mein Banu Tamim ki ek nadar burhiya raste mein mujhe mili aur yeh khwahish zahir ki ke main ise apne sath aap ki khidmat mein pahunchaun, chunancha main ise apne sath laya hoon aur woh darwaza par muntazir hai." Aap ne farmaya, "Ise bhi andar bula lo." Chunancha woh aa gayin. Main ne kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah! Agar aap hum mein aur Banu Tamim mein koi rok kar sakte hain to ise kar dijiye." Is par burhiya ko hamiyat lahaq hui aur woh bharayi hui aawaz mein bol uthi ke, "Phir Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Aap ka muztar kahan qarar kare ga?" Main ne kaha, "SubhanAllah! Meri to wahi misl hui ke 'apne paon mein aap hi kulhari maari'. Mujhe kya khabar thi ke yeh meri hi dushmani karegi? Warna main ise lata hi kyun? Allah ki panah! Wallah kahin aisa na ho ke main bhi misl-e-Aadiyon ke qasid ke ho jaun." Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke Aadiyon ke qasid ka waqea kya hai?

Ba-wujood-e-ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqia se ba-nisbat mere bahut zyada waqif thay lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman par main ne woh qissa bayan kiya ke Aadiyon ki bastiyon mein jab sakht qahat-sali hui toh unhon ne apna ek qasid Qail nami rawana kiya, yeh raaste mein Muawiya bin Bakr ke yahan aakar thehra aur sharab peene laga aur us ki dono kaneezon ka gana sunne mein jin ka naam Jarada tha is qadar mashghool hua ke mahina bhar tak yahin pada raha phir chala aur Jibal-e-Mahra mein ja kar us ne dua ki ke Allah tu khoob jaanta hai main kisi mareez ki dawa ke liye ya kisi qaidi ka fidiya ada karne ke liye toh aaya nahin, Ilahi Aadiyon ko woh pila jo tu ne unhein pilane wala hai, chunancha chand siyah rang badal uthay aur un mein se ek aawaz aayi ke in mein se jisay tu chahay pasand kar le, chunancha us ne sakht siyah badal ko pasand kar liya, isi waqt un mein se ek aawaz aayi ke isay raakh aur khaak banane wala kar de taake Aadiyon mein se koi baqi na rahay. Kaha aur mujhe jahan tak ilm hua hai yahi hai ke hawaon ke makhzan mein se sirf pehle hi soorakh se hawa chhori gayi thi jaise meri is angoothi ka halqa, isi se sab halak ho gaye. Abu Wail kehte hain yeh bilkul theek naqal hai, Arab mein dastoor tha ke jab kisi qasid ko bhejte toh keh dete ke Aadiyon ke qasid ki tarah na karna. Yeh riwayat Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai. Jaise ke Surah Al-A'raf ki tafsir mein guzra, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se marwi hai ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko kabhi khil-khila kar is tarah hanste hue nahin dekha ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke masoorhay nazar aayen. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sirf tabassum farmaya karte thay aur jab abr uthta aur aandhi chalti toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chehre se fikr ke aasar namoodar ho jate. Chunancha ek roz main ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) log toh abr-o-baad ko dekh kar khush hote hain ke ab barish barse gi lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki is ke bilkul bar-aks halat ho jati hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ayesha! Main is baat se ke kahin is mein azab ho kaise mutma'in ho jaon? Ek qoum hawa hi se halak ki gayi, ek qoum ne azab ke badal ko dekh kaha tha ke yeh abr hai jo hum par barish barsaye ga. Sahih Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat dusri sanad se marwi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab kabhi aasman ke kisi kinare se abr uthta hua dekhte toh apne tamam kaam chhor dete agarche namaz mein hon aur yeh dua parhte (Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi) Allah main tujh se is burai se panah chahta hoon jo is mein hai. Pas agar khul jata toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki hamd karte aur agar baras jata toh yeh dua parhte (Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an) Aye Allah isay nafa dene wala aur barasne wala bana de.

Sahih Muslim mein riwayat hai ke jab hawayein chaltin toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh dua parhte (Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha wa khaira ma fiha wa khaira ma ursilat bihi wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ursilat bihi) ya Allah main tujh se is ki aur is mein jo hai us ki aur jis ke yeh sath le kar aayi hai us ki bhalai talab karta hoon aur tujh se is ki aur is mein jo hai us ki aur jis cheez ke sath yeh bheji gayi hai us ki burai se panah chahta hoon. Aur jab abr uthta toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka rang mutaghayyar ho jata, kabhi andar kabhi bahar aate kabhi jate. Jab barish ho jati toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh fikrmandi door ho jati. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne ise samajh liya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek baar sawal kiya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya ke Ayesha khauf is baat ka hota hai ke kahin yeh isi tarah na ho jis tarah Qaum-e-Hud ne apni taraf badal barhta dekh kar khushi se kaha tha ke yeh abr hamain sairab kare ga. Surah Al-A'raf mein Aadiyon ki halakat ka aur Hazrat Hud (A.S) ka poora waqea guzar chuka hai is liye hum ise yahan nahin dohrate (Falillahil Hamdu wal Minnah). Tabrani ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Aadiyon par itni hi hawa kholi gayi thi jitna angoothi ka halqa hota hai, yeh hawa pehle dehat walon aur badiyanashinon par aayi wahan se shehri logon par aayi jise dekh kar yeh kehne lage ke yeh abr jo hamari taraf barha chala aa raha hai yeh zaroor hum par barish barsaye ga lekin yeh jungli log thay jo in shehrion par gira diye gaye aur sab halak ho gaye, hawa ke khazanchiyon par hawa ki sarkashi us waqt itni thi ke darwazon ke surakhon se woh nikli ja rahi thi, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam.

Qaum-e-Aad ki tabahi ke asbab. Janab-e-Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasalli ke liye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke agar aap ki qaum aap ko jhutlaye toh aap aglay ambiya ke waqiyat yaad kar lijiye ke un ki qaum ne bhi un ki takzeeb ki. Aadiyon ke bhai se murad Hazrat Hud Paighambar (A.S / Alaihis Salam) hain. Unhein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne Aad-e-Ula ki taraf bheja tha jo Ahqaf mein rehte thay. Ahqaf jama hai Haqf ki aur Haqf kehte hain ret ke pahar ko. Mutlaq pahar aur ghar aur Hadhramaut ki wadi jis ka naam Barhut hai jahan kuffar ki roohein dali jati hain, yeh matlab bhi Ahqaf ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Qatada ka qaul hai ke Yaman mein samundar ke kinare ret ke telon mein ek jagah thi jis ka naam Shahr tha, yahan yeh log abad thay. Imam Ibn-e-Majah ne baab bandha hai ke jab dua mange toh apne nafs se shuru kare, is mein ek hadith laye hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala hum par aur Aadiyon ke bhai par raham kare. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Azza-o-Jal ne un ke ird-gird ke shahron mein bhi apne Rasool mab'oos farmaye thay. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (فَجَــعَلْنٰھَا نَكَالًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ 66) (2. Al-Baqarah: 66) aur jaise Allah Jalla-o-Ala ka farman hai ayat (فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَقُلْ اَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ 13ۭ) (41. Fussilat: 13), phir farmata hai ke Hazrat Hud (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne apni qaum se farmaya ke tum muwahhid ban jao warna tumhein is baray bhari din mein azab hoga. Jis par qaum ne kaha kya tu hamein hamaray maboodon se rok raha hai? Ja jis azab se tu hamein dara raha hai woh le aa. Yeh toh apne zehan mein isay muhaal jantay thay toh jurrat kar ke jald talab kiya. Jaise ke aur ayat mein hai ayat (يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهَا 18؀) (42. Ash-Shura: 18) yani iman na lanay walay hamaray azabon ke jald aanay ki khwahish kartay hain. Is ke jawab mein un ke paighambar ne kaha ke Allah hi ko behtar ilm hai agar woh tumhein isi laiq janay ga toh tum par azab bhej de ga. Mera mansab toh sirf itna hi hai ke main apne Rabb ki risalat tumhein pahuncha doon lekin main janta hoon ke tum bilkul be-aql aur bewaqoof log ho. Ab Allah ka azab aa gaya, unhon ne dekha ke ek kala abr un ki taraf barhta chala aa raha hai. Chunke khushk-sali thi, garmi sakht thi, yeh khushiyan mananay lagay ke acha hua abr charha hai aur isi taraf rukh hai ab barish barse gi. Dar-asal abr ki soorat mein yeh woh qahr-e-Ilahi tha jis ke aanay ki woh jaldi macha rahay thay. Is mein woh azab tha jisay Hazrat Hud (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se yeh talab kar rahay thay. Woh azab un ki bastiyon ki tamam un cheezon ko bhi jin ki barbadi honay wali thi tahas-nahas karta hua aaya aur isi ka isay Allah ka hukum tha jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيْمِ 42؀ۭ) (51. Adh-Dhariyat: 42) yani jis cheez par woh guzar jati thi usay choora choora kar deti thi.

Pas sab ke sab halak-o-tabah ho gaye, ek bhi na bach saka. Phir farmata hai hum isi tarah un ka faisla karte hain jo hamare Rasoolon ko jhutlayein aur hamare ahkaam ki khilaf warzi karein. Ek bahut hi ghareeb hadith mein un ka jo qissa aaya hai woh bhi sun lijiye. Hazrat Haris (R.A) kehte hain main Ala bin Hazrami ki shikayat le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein ja raha tha. Rabzah mein mujhe Banu Tamim ki ek burhiya mili jis ke paas sawari waghera na thi, mujh se kehne lagi, "Ae Allah ke bande! Mera ek kaam Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se hai, kya tu mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ) tak pahuncha de ga?" Main ne iqrar kiya aur unhein apni sawari par bitha liya aur Madina Sharif pahuncha. Main ne dekha ke Masjid-e-Sharif logon se khacha-khach bhari hui hai, siyah rang jhanda lehra raha hai aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) talwar latkaye Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne khade hain. Main ne daryaft kiya ke kya baat hai? To logon ne mujh se kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ) Amr bin Aas (R.A) ko kisi taraf bhejna chahte hain." Main ek taraf baith gaya, jab An-Huzoor (ﷺ) apni manzil ya apne khaime mein tashreef le gaye to main bhi gaya, ijazat talab ki aur ijazat milne par aap ki khidmat mein baryab hua. Salam kiya to aap ne mujh se daryaft farmaya ke kya tumhare aur Banu Tamim ke darmiyan kuch ranjish thi? Main ne kaha, "Haan aur hum un par ghalib rahe the aur ab mere is safar mein Banu Tamim ki ek nadar burhiya raste mein mujhe mili aur yeh khwahish zahir ki ke main ise apne sath aap ki khidmat mein pahunchaun, chunancha main ise apne sath laya hoon aur woh darwaza par muntazir hai." Aap ne farmaya, "Ise bhi andar bula lo." Chunancha woh aa gayin. Main ne kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah! Agar aap hum mein aur Banu Tamim mein koi rok kar sakte hain to ise kar dijiye." Is par burhiya ko hamiyat lahaq hui aur woh bharayi hui aawaz mein bol uthi ke, "Phir Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Aap ka muztar kahan qarar kare ga?" Main ne kaha, "SubhanAllah! Meri to wahi misl hui ke 'apne paon mein aap hi kulhari maari'. Mujhe kya khabar thi ke yeh meri hi dushmani karegi? Warna main ise lata hi kyun? Allah ki panah! Wallah kahin aisa na ho ke main bhi misl-e-Aadiyon ke qasid ke ho jaun." Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke Aadiyon ke qasid ka waqea kya hai?
