Mera ek kaam Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se hai, kya tu mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ) tak pahuncha de ga?" Main ne iqrar kiya aur unhein apni sawari par bitha liya aur Madina Sharif pahuncha. Main ne dekha ke Masjid-e-Sharif logon se khacha-khach bhari hui hai, siyah rang jhanda lehra raha hai aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) talwar latkaye Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne khade hain. Main ne daryaft kiya ke kya baat hai? To logon ne mujh se kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ) Amr bin Aas (R.A) ko kisi taraf bhejna chahte hain." Main ek taraf baith gaya, jab An-Huzoor (ﷺ) apni manzil ya apne khaime mein tashreef le gaye to main bhi gaya, ijazat talab ki aur ijazat milne par aap ki khidmat mein baryab hua. Salam kiya to aap ne mujh se daryaft farmaya ke kya tumhare aur Banu Tamim ke darmiyan kuch ranjish thi? Main ne kaha, "Haan aur hum un par ghalib rahe the aur ab mere is safar mein Banu Tamim ki ek nadar burhiya raste mein mujhe mili aur yeh khwahish zahir ki ke main ise apne sath aap ki khidmat mein pahunchaun, chunancha main ise apne sath laya hoon aur woh darwaza par muntazir hai." Aap ne farmaya, "Ise bhi andar bula lo." Chunancha woh aa gayin. Main ne kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah! Agar aap hum mein aur Banu Tamim mein koi rok kar sakte hain to ise kar dijiye." Is par burhiya ko hamiyat lahaq hui aur woh bharayi hui aawaz mein bol uthi ke, "Phir Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Aap ka muztar kahan qarar kare ga?" Main ne kaha, "SubhanAllah! Meri to wahi misl hui ke 'apne paon mein aap hi kulhari maari'. Mujhe kya khabar thi ke yeh meri hi dushmani karegi? Warna main ise lata hi kyun? Allah ki panah! Wallah kahin aisa na ho ke main bhi misl-e-Aadiyon ke qasid ke ho jaun." Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke Aadiyon ke qasid ka waqea kya hai?

Ba-wujood-e-ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqia se ba-nisbat mere bahut zyada waqif thay lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman par main ne woh qissa bayan kiya ke Aadiyon ki bastiyon mein jab sakht qahat-sali hui toh unhon ne apna ek qasid Qail nami rawana kiya, yeh raaste mein Muawiya bin Bakr ke yahan aakar thehra aur sharab peene laga aur us ki dono kaneezon ka gana sunne mein jin ka naam Jarada tha is qadar mashghool hua ke mahina bhar tak yahin pada raha phir chala aur Jibal-e-Mahra mein ja kar us ne dua ki ke Allah tu khoob jaanta hai main kisi mareez ki dawa ke liye ya kisi qaidi ka fidiya ada karne ke liye toh aaya nahin, Ilahi Aadiyon ko woh pila jo tu ne unhein pilane wala hai, chunancha chand siyah rang badal uthay aur un mein se ek aawaz aayi ke in mein se jisay tu chahay pasand kar le, chunancha us ne sakht siyah badal ko pasand kar liya, isi waqt un mein se ek aawaz aayi ke isay raakh aur khaak banane wala kar de taake Aadiyon mein se koi baqi na rahay. Kaha aur mujhe jahan tak ilm hua hai yahi hai ke hawaon ke makhzan mein se sirf pehle hi soorakh se hawa chhori gayi thi jaise meri is angoothi ka halqa, isi se sab halak ho gaye. Abu Wail kehte hain yeh bilkul theek naqal hai, Arab mein dastoor tha ke jab kisi qasid ko bhejte toh keh dete ke Aadiyon ke qasid ki tarah na karna. Yeh riwayat Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai. Jaise ke Surah Al-A'raf ki tafsir mein guzra, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se marwi hai ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko kabhi khil-khila kar is tarah hanste hue nahin dekha ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke masoorhay nazar aayen. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sirf tabassum farmaya karte thay aur jab abr uthta aur aandhi chalti toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chehre se fikr ke aasar namoodar ho jate. Chunancha ek roz main ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) log toh abr-o-baad ko dekh kar khush hote hain ke ab barish barse gi lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki is ke bilkul bar-aks halat ho jati hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ayesha! Main is baat se ke kahin is mein azab ho kaise mutma'in ho jaon? Ek qoum hawa hi se halak ki gayi, ek qoum ne azab ke badal ko dekh kaha tha ke yeh abr hai jo hum par barish barsaye ga. Sahih Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat dusri sanad se marwi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab kabhi aasman ke kisi kinare se abr uthta hua dekhte toh apne tamam kaam chhor dete agarche namaz mein hon aur yeh dua parhte (Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi) Allah main tujh se is burai se panah chahta hoon jo is mein hai. Pas agar khul jata toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki hamd karte aur agar baras jata toh yeh dua parhte (Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an) Aye Allah isay nafa dene wala aur barasne wala bana de.

Sahih Muslim mein riwayat hai ke jab hawayein chaltin toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh dua parhte (Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha wa khaira ma fiha wa khaira ma ursilat bihi wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ursilat bihi) ya Allah main tujh se is ki aur is mein jo hai us ki aur jis ke yeh sath le kar aayi hai us ki bhalai talab karta hoon aur tujh se is ki aur is mein jo hai us ki aur jis cheez ke sath yeh bheji gayi hai us ki burai se panah chahta hoon. Aur jab abr uthta toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka rang mutaghayyar ho jata, kabhi andar kabhi bahar aate kabhi jate. Jab barish ho jati toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh fikrmandi door ho jati. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne ise samajh liya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek baar sawal kiya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya ke Ayesha khauf is baat ka hota hai ke kahin yeh isi tarah na ho jis tarah Qaum-e-Hud ne apni taraf badal barhta dekh kar khushi se kaha tha ke yeh abr hamain sairab kare ga. Surah Al-A'raf mein Aadiyon ki halakat ka aur Hazrat Hud (A.S) ka poora waqea guzar chuka hai is liye hum ise yahan nahin dohrate (Falillahil Hamdu wal Minnah). Tabrani ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Aadiyon par itni hi hawa kholi gayi thi jitna angoothi ka halqa hota hai, yeh hawa pehle dehat walon aur badiyanashinon par aayi wahan se shehri logon par aayi jise dekh kar yeh kehne lage ke yeh abr jo hamari taraf barha chala aa raha hai yeh zaroor hum par barish barsaye ga lekin yeh jungli log thay jo in shehrion par gira diye gaye aur sab halak ho gaye, hawa ke khazanchiyon par hawa ki sarkashi us waqt itni thi ke darwazon ke surakhon se woh nikli ja rahi thi, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam.

Qaum-e-Aad ki tabahi ke asbab. Janab-e-Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasalli ke liye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke agar aap ki qaum aap ko jhutlaye toh aap aglay ambiya ke waqiyat yaad kar lijiye ke un ki qaum ne bhi un ki takzeeb ki. Aadiyon ke bhai se murad Hazrat Hud Paighambar (A.S / Alaihis Salam) hain. Unhein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne Aad-e-Ula ki taraf bheja tha jo Ahqaf mein rehte thay. Ahqaf jama hai Haqf ki aur Haqf kehte hain ret ke pahar ko. Mutlaq pahar aur ghar aur Hadhramaut ki wadi jis ka naam Barhut hai jahan kuffar ki roohein dali jati hain, yeh matlab bhi Ahqaf ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Qatada ka qaul hai ke Yaman mein samundar ke kinare ret ke telon mein ek jagah thi jis ka naam Shahr tha, yahan yeh log abad thay. Imam Ibn-e-Majah ne baab bandha hai ke jab dua mange toh apne nafs se shuru kare, is mein ek hadith laye hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala hum par aur Aadiyon ke bhai par raham kare. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Azza-o-Jal ne un ke ird-gird ke shahron mein bhi apne Rasool mab'oos farmaye thay. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (فَجَــعَلْنٰھَا نَكَالًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ 66) (2. Al-Baqarah: 66) aur jaise Allah Jalla-o-Ala ka farman hai ayat (فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَقُلْ اَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ 13ۭ) (41. Yeh toh apne zehan mein isay muhaal jantay thay toh jurrat kar ke jald talab kiya. Jaise ke aur ayat mein hai ayat (يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهَا 18؀) (42. Mera mansab toh sirf itna hi hai ke main apne Rabb ki risalat tumhein pahuncha doon lekin main janta hoon ke tum bilkul be-aql aur bewaqoof log ho. Ab Allah ka azab aa gaya, unhon ne dekha ke ek kala abr un ki taraf barhta chala aa raha hai. Chunke khushk-sali thi, garmi sakht thi, yeh khushiyan mananay lagay ke acha hua abr charha hai aur isi taraf rukh hai ab barish barse gi. Dar-asal abr ki soorat mein yeh woh qahr-e-Ilahi tha jis ke aanay ki woh jaldi macha rahay thay. Is mein woh azab tha jisay Hazrat Hud (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se yeh talab kar rahay thay. Woh azab un ki bastiyon ki tamam un cheezon ko bhi jin ki barbadi honay wali thi tahas-nahas karta hua aaya aur isi ka isay Allah ka hukum tha jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيْمِ 42؀ۭ) (51. Is ke jawab mein un ke paighambar ne kaha ke Allah hi ko behtar ilm hai agar woh tumhein isi laiq janay ga toh tum par azab bhej de ga. Mera mansab toh sirf itna hi hai ke main apne Rabb ki risalat tumhein pahuncha doon lekin main janta hoon ke tum bilkul be-aql aur bewaqoof log ho. Ab Allah ka azab aa gaya, unhon ne dekha ke ek kala abr un ki taraf barhta chala aa raha hai. Chunke khushk-sali thi, garmi sakht thi, yeh khushiyan mananay lagay ke acha hua abr charha hai aur isi taraf rukh hai ab barish barse gi. Dar-asal abr ki soorat mein yeh woh qahr-e-Ilahi tha jis ke aanay ki woh jaldi macha rahay thay. Is mein woh azab tha jisay Hazrat Hud (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se yeh talab kar rahay thay. Woh azab un ki bastiyon ki tamam un cheezon ko bhi jin ki barbadi honay wali thi tahas-nahas karta hua aaya aur isi ka isay Allah ka hukum tha jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ اَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيْمِ 42؀ۭ) (51. Adh-Dhariyat: 42) yani jis cheez par woh guzar jati thi usay choora choora kar deti thi.

Pas sab ke sab halak-o-tabah ho gaye, ek bhi na bach saka. Phir farmata hai hum isi tarah un ka faisla karte hain jo hamare Rasoolon ko jhutlayein aur hamare ahkaam ki khilaf warzi karein. Ek bahut hi ghareeb hadith mein un ka jo qissa aaya hai woh bhi sun lijiye. Hazrat Haris (R.A) kehte hain main Ala bin Hazrami ki shikayat le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein ja raha tha. Rabzah mein mujhe Banu Tamim ki ek burhiya mili jis ke paas sawari waghera na thi, mujh se kehne lagi, "Ae Allah ke bande! Mera ek kaam Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se hai, kya tu mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ) tak pahuncha de ga?" Main ne iqrar kiya aur unhein apni sawari par bitha liya aur Madina Sharif pahuncha. Main ne dekha ke Masjid-e-Sharif logon se khacha-khach bhari hui hai, siyah rang jhanda lehra raha hai aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) talwar latkaye Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne khade hain. Main ne daryaft kiya ke kya baat hai? To logon ne mujh se kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ) Amr bin Aas (R.A) ko kisi taraf bhejna chahte hain." Main ek taraf baith gaya, jab An-Huzoor (ﷺ) apni manzil ya apne khaime mein tashreef le gaye to main bhi gaya, ijazat talab ki aur ijazat milne par aap ki khidmat mein baryab hua. Salam kiya to aap ne mujh se daryaft farmaya ke kya tumhare aur Banu Tamim ke darmiyan kuch ranjish thi? Main ne kaha, "Haan aur hum un par ghalib rahe the aur ab mere is safar mein Banu Tamim ki ek nadar burhiya raste mein mujhe mili aur yeh khwahish zahir ki ke main ise apne sath aap ki khidmat mein pahunchaun, chunancha main ise apne sath laya hoon aur woh darwaza par muntazir hai." Aap ne farmaya, "Ise bhi andar bula lo." Chunancha woh aa gayin. Main ne kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah! Agar aap hum mein aur Banu Tamim mein koi rok kar sakte hain to ise kar dijiye." Is par burhiya ko hamiyat lahaq hui aur woh bharayi hui aawaz mein bol uthi ke, "Phir Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Aap ka muztar kahan qarar kare ga?" Main ne kaha, "SubhanAllah! Meri to wahi misl hui ke 'apne paon mein aap hi kulhari maari'. Mujhe kya khabar thi ke yeh meri hi dushmani karegi? Warna main ise lata hi kyun? Allah ki panah! Wallah kahin aisa na ho ke main bhi misl-e-Aadiyon ke qasid ke ho jaun." Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke Aadiyon ke qasid ka waqea kya hai?

Ba-wujood-e-ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqia se ba-nisbat mere bahut zyada waqif thay lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman par main ne woh qissa bayan kiya ke Aadiyon ki bastiyon mein jab sakht qahat-sali hui toh unhon ne apna ek qasid Qail nami rawana kiya, yeh raaste mein Muawiya bin Bakr ke yahan aakar thehra aur sharab peene laga aur us ki dono kaneezon ka gana sunne mein jin ka naam Jarada tha is qadar mashghool hua ke mahina bhar tak yahin pada raha phir chala aur Jibal-e-Mahra mein ja kar us ne dua ki ke Allah tu khoob jaanta hai main kisi mareez ki dawa ke liye ya kisi qaidi ka fidiya ada karne ke liye toh aaya nahin, Ilahi Aadiyon ko woh pila jo tu ne unhein pilane wala hai, chunancha chand siyah rang badal uthay aur un mein se ek aawaz aayi ke in mein se jisay tu chahay pasand kar le, chunancha us ne sakht siyah badal ko pasand kar liya, isi waqt un mein se ek aawaz aayi ke isay raakh aur khaak banane wala kar de taake Aadiyon mein se koi baqi na rahay. Kaha aur mujhe jahan tak ilm hua hai yahi hai ke hawaon ke makhzan mein se sirf pehle hi soorakh se hawa chhori gayi thi jaise meri is angoothi ka halqa, isi se sab halak ho gaye. Abu Wail kehte hain yeh bilkul theek naqal hai, Arab mein dastoor tha ke jab kisi qasid ko bhejte toh keh dete ke Aadiyon ke qasid ki tarah na karna. Yeh riwayat Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai. Jaise ke Surah Al-A'raf ki tafsir mein guzra, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se marwi hai ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko kabhi khil-khila kar is tarah hanste hue nahin dekha ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke masoorhay nazar aayen. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sirf tabassum farmaya karte thay aur jab abr uthta aur aandhi chalti toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chehre se fikr ke aasar namoodar ho jate. Chunancha ek roz main ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) log toh abr-o-baad ko dekh kar khush hote hain ke ab barish barse gi lekin Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki is ke bilkul bar-aks halat ho jati hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ayesha! Main is baat se ke kahin is mein azab ho kaise mutma'in ho jaon? Ek qoum hawa hi se halak ki gayi, ek qoum ne azab ke badal ko dekh kaha tha ke yeh abr hai jo hum par barish barsaye ga. Sahih Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat dusri sanad se marwi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab kabhi aasman ke kisi kinare se abr uthta hua dekhte toh apne tamam kaam chhor dete agarche namaz mein hon aur yeh dua parhte (Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi) Allah main tujh se is burai se panah chahta hoon jo is mein hai. Pas agar khul jata toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki hamd karte aur agar baras jata toh yeh dua parhte (Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an) Aye Allah isay nafa dene wala aur barasne wala bana de.

Sahih Muslim mein riwayat hai ke jab hawayein chaltin toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh dua parhte (Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha wa khaira ma fiha wa khaira ma ursilat bihi wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ursilat bihi) ya Allah main tujh se is ki aur is mein jo hai us ki aur jis ke yeh sath le kar aayi hai us ki bhalai talab karta hoon aur tujh se is ki aur is mein jo hai us ki aur jis cheez ke sath yeh bheji gayi hai us ki burai se panah chahta hoon. Aur jab abr uthta toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka rang mutaghayyar ho jata, kabhi andar kabhi bahar aate kabhi jate. Jab barish ho jati toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh fikrmandi door ho jati. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne ise samajh liya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek baar sawal kiya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab diya ke Ayesha khauf is baat ka hota hai ke kahin yeh isi tarah na ho jis tarah Qaum-e-Hud ne apni taraf badal barhta dekh kar khushi se kaha tha ke yeh abr hamain sairab kare ga. Surah Al-A'raf mein Aadiyon ki halakat ka aur Hazrat Hud (A.S) ka poora waqea guzar chuka hai is liye hum ise yahan nahin dohrate (Falillahil Hamdu wal Minnah). Tabrani ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Aadiyon par itni hi hawa kholi gayi thi jitna angoothi ka halqa hota hai, yeh hawa pehle dehat walon aur badiyanashinon par aayi wahan se shehri logon par aayi jise dekh kar yeh kehne lage ke yeh abr jo hamari taraf barha chala aa raha hai yeh zaroor hum par barish barsaye ga lekin yeh jungli log thay jo in shehrion par gira diye gaye aur sab halak ho gaye, hawa ke khazanchiyon par hawa ki sarkashi us waqt itni thi ke darwazon ke surakhon se woh nikli ja rahi thi, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam.

Maghzoob shuda qomon ki nishandahi irshad hota hai ke agli ummaton ko jo asbab-e-duniyawi maal-o-aulad waghera hamari taraf se diye gaye thay waise to tumhein ab tak muhayya bhi nahin, un ke bhi kaan, aankhein aur dil thay lekin jis waqt unhon ne hamari aayaton ka inkar kiya aur hamare azabon ka mazaq udaya to bilakhir un ke zahiri asbab unhein kuch kaam na aaye aur woh sazayein un par baras padein jin ki yeh hamesha hansi karte rahe thay. Pas tumhein un ki tarah na hona chahiye, aisa na ho ke un ke se azab tum par bhi aa jayein aur tum bhi un ki tarah jad se kaat diye jao. Phir irshad hota hai, ae Ahl-e-Makkah! Tum apne aas paas hi ek nazar dalo aur dekho ke kis qadar qomein neest-o-nabood kar di gayi hain aur kis tarah unhon ne apne kartoot badle paye hain. Ahqaf jo Yaman ke paas hai, Hadhramaut ke ilaqe mein hai, yahan ke basne wale Aadiyon ke anjam par nazar dalo. Tumhare aur Shaam ke darmiyan Thamudiyon ka jo hashr hua use dekho, Ahl-e-Yaman aur Ahl-e-Madyan ki qoum-e-Saba ke natije par gaur karo. Tum to aksar ghazwat aur tijarat waghera ke liye wahan se aate jaate rehte ho, Behaira-e-Qoum-e-Loot se ibrat hasil karo, woh bhi tumhare raaste mein hi padta hai. Phir farmata hai hum ne apni nishaniyon aur aayaton se khoob wazeh kar diya hai taake log buraiyon se bhalaiyon ki taraf laut aayein. Phir farmata hai ke in logon ne Allah Ta'ala ke siwa jin jin maboodan-e-batil ki parastish shuru kar rakhi thi, go is mein un ka apna khayal tha ke is ki wajah se hum qurb-e-Ilahi hasil karenge, lekin kya hamare azabon ke waqt jabke un ko un ki madad ki poori zaroorat thi, unhon ne un ki kisi tarah madad ki? Hargiz nahin, balkeh un ki ehtiyaj aur museebat ke waqt woh gum ho gaye, un se bhaag gaye, un ka pata bhi na chala. Al-gharaz un ka poojna sareeh ghalti thi, gharaz jhoot tha aur saaf iftira aur fazool bohtan tha ke yeh unhein mabood samajh rahe thay. Pas un ki ibadat karne mein aur un par aitmad karne mein yeh dhoke mein aur nuqsan mein hi rahe, Wallahu A'lam.

Taif se wapsi par jinnaat ne Kalam-e-Ilahi suna, Shaitan bokhlaya. Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein Hazrat Zubair R.A se is aayat ki tafsir mein marvi hai ke yeh waqia Nakhla ka hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us waqt namaz-e-isha ada kar rahe thay, yeh sab jinnaat simat kar aap ke gird-o-pesh bheer ki shakal mein kharay ho gaye. Ibn Abbas R.A ki riwayat mein hai ke yeh jinnaat (Naseebain) ke thay, tadaad mein saat thay. Kitab Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein barwayat Ibn Abbas R.A marvi hai ke na toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jinnaat ko sunane ki gharz se Quran parha tha na aap ne unhein dekha. Aap toh apne sahaba ke sath Ukaz ke bazaar ja rahe thay. Udhar yeh hua tha ke shaitan ke aur aasmanon ki khabron ke darmiyan rok ho gayi thi aur un par sholay barsne shuru ho gaye thay. Shaitan ne aakar apni qoum ko yeh khabar di toh unhon ne kaha koi na koi nayi baat paida hui hai, jao talash karo. Pas yeh nikal kharay hue. Un mein ki jo jamaat Arab ki taraf mutawajja hui thi woh jab yahan pahunchi tab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Souq-e-Ukaz ki taraf jate hue Nakhla mein apne as-haab ko namaz parha rahe thay. Un ke kanon mein jab aap ki tilawat ki aawaz pahunchi toh yeh thahar gaye aur kaan laga kar baghaur sunne lage. Is ke baad unhon ne faisla kar liya ke bas yahi woh cheez hai jis ki wajah se tumhara aasmanon tak pahunchna mauqoof kar diya gaya hai. Yahan se foran hi wapas laut kar apni qoum ke paas pahunche aur un se kahne lage hum ne ajeeb Quran suna jo neki ka rahbar hai, hum toh is par iman la chuke aur iqrar karte hain ke ab namumkin hai ke Allah ke sath hum kisi aur ko shareek karein. Is waqia ki khabar Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ko Surah Jinn mein di, yeh hadith Bukhari o Muslim waghera mein bhi hai. Musnad mein hai Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jinnaat Wahi-e-Ilahi suna karte thay, ek kalma jab un ke kaan mein parh jata toh woh is mein das mila liya karte, pas woh ek toh haq nikalta baqi sab batil nikalte aur is se pehle un par taaray phenke nahin jate thay. Pas jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mab'oos hue toh un par shola-bari hone lagi. Yeh apne baithne ki jagah pahunchte aur un par shola girta aur yeh thahar na sakte. Unhon ne aakar Iblees se yeh shikayat ki toh unhon ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Nakhla ki dono pahariyon ke darmiyan namaz parhte hue paya aur ja kar use khabar di. Us ne kaha bas yahi wajah hai jo aasman mehfooz kar diya gaya aur tumhara jana band hua. Yeh riwayat Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi hai. Hasan Basri R.H ka qaul bhi yahi hai ke is waqia ki khabar tak Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko na thi, jab aap par wahi aayi tab aap ne yeh maloom kiya. Seerat-e-Ibn Ishaq mein Muhammad bin Ka'ab R.H ka ek lamba bayan manqool hai jis mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka Taif jana, unhein Islam ki dawat dena, un ka inkar karna waghera poora waqia bayan hai.

Hazrat Hasan R.A ne is dua ka bhi zikr kiya hai jo Aap ﷺ ne is tangi ke waqt ki thi jo yeh hai: (Allahumma ilaika ashku da'fa quwwati wa qillata heelati wa hawani 'alan-nasi ya arhamar-rahimeen anta arhamur-rahimeen wa anta rabbul-mustad'afeena wa anta rabbi ila man takiluni ila 'aduwwin ba'eedin yatajahhamuni am ila sadeeqin qareebin mallaktahu amri in lam yakun bika ghadabun 'alayya fala ubali ghaira anna 'afiyataka awsa'u li a'udhu bi-noori wajhikalladhi ashraqat lahu-z-zulumatu wa saluha 'alaihi amrud-dunya wal-akhirati an yanzila bi ghadabuka aw yahilla bi sakhatuka wa lakal-'utba hatta tarda wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bik). Ya'ni apni kamzori aur besaro-samani aur kasm-porsi ki shikayat sirf tere samne karta hoon. Aye Arhamar-Rahimeen tu darasal sab se zyada raham-o-karam karne wala hai aur kamzoron ka Rab tu hi hai, mera palanhar bhi tu hi hai, tu mujhe kis ko sonp raha hai? Kisi doori wale dushman ko jo mujhe aajiz kar de ya kisi qurb wale dost ko jise tu ne mere bare ikhtiyar de rakha ho, agar teri koi khafgi mujh par na ho to mujhe is dard-o-dukh ki koi parwah nahin, lekin taham agar tu mujhe 'afiyat ke sath hi rakh to woh mere liye bahut hi rahat-rasan hai. Main tere chehre ke us noor ke ba'is jis ki wajah se tamam andheriyan jagmaga uthi hain aur deen-o-dunya ke tamam umoor ki islah ka madar isi par hai, tujh se is baat ki panah talab karta hoon ki mujh par tera 'itab aur tera gussa nazil ho ya teri narazgi mujh par aajaye, mujhe teri hi razamandi aur khushnudi darkar hai aur neki karne aur badi se bachne ki taqat teri hi madad se hai. Isi safar ki wapsi mein Aap ﷺ ne Nakhla mein raat guzari aur isi raat Quran ki tilawat karte hue (Naseebain) ke jinnon ne Aap ﷺ ko suna, yeh hai to sahi lekin is mein qaul ta'ammul talab hai, is liye ke jinnat ka Kalamullah shareef sunne ka waqia wahi shuru hone ke zamane ka hai jaise ke Ibn Abbas R.A ki oopar bayan karda hadith se sabit ho raha hai aur Aap ﷺ ka Taif jana apne chacha Abu Talib ke inteqal ke baad hua hai jo hijrat ke ek ya zyada se zyada do saal pehle ka waqia hai jaise ke Seerat Ibn Ishaq waghera mein hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn Abi Shaiba mein in jinnat ki ginti nau (9) ki hai jin mein se ek ka naam Zau'a hai. Inhi ke bare mein yeh ayatein nazil hui hain. Pas yeh riwayat aur is se pehle ki Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ki riwayat ka iqtiza yeh hai ke is martaba jo jinn aaye the un ki maujoodgi ka Huzoor ﷺ ko ilm na tha, yeh to Aap ﷺ ki be-khabari mein hi Aap ﷺ ki zabani Quran sun kar wapas laut gaye, is ke baad bator wafd faujein ki faujein aur jathay ke jathay un ke Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue jaise ke is zikr ke ahadith-o-asar apni jagah aa rahe hain Insha'Allah. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Hazrat Abdur-Rahman ne Hazrat Masrooq se poocha ke jis raat jinnat ne Huzoor ﷺ se Quran suna tha us raat kis ne Huzoor ﷺ se un ka zikr kiya tha? To farmaya mujh se tere walid Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A ne kaha hai un ki agahi Huzoor ﷺ ko ek darakht ne di thi, to mumkin hai ke yeh khabar pehli dafa ki ho aur isbat ko hum nafi par muqaddam maan lein.

Aur yeh bhi ehtemal hai ke jab woh sun rahe thay Aap ko toh koi khabar na thi yahan tak ke is darakht ne Aap ko un ke ijtima ki khabar di, Wallahu A'lam. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh waqia is ke baad wale kayi waqiat mein se ek ho, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Hafiz Baihaqi R.H farmate hain ke pehli martaba toh na Rasool Allah ﷺ ne jinnon ko dekha na khaas un ke sunane ke liye Quran parha, haan albatta is ke baad jinn Aap ke paas aaye aur Aap ne unhein Quran parh kar sunaya aur Allah Azzawajal ki taraf bulaya, jaise ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se marwi hai. Is ki riwayatein suniye. Hazrat Alqama R.H, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se poochte hain ke kya tum mein se koi us raat Huzoor ﷺ ke saath majood tha? Toh Aap ne jawab diya ke koi na tha, Aap raat bhar hum se ghaib rahe aur hamein reh reh kar baar baar yahi khayal guzra karta tha ke shayad kisi dushman ne Aap ko dhoka de diya, Allah na kare Aap ke saath koi na-khushgawar waqia pesh aaya ho. Woh raat hamari bari buri tarah kati, subh-e-sadiq se kuch hi pehle hum ne dekha ke Aap Ghaar-e-Hira se wapas aa rahe hain, pas hum ne raat ki apni saari kaifiyat bayan kar di hai. Toh Aap ne farmaya mere paas jinnaat ka qasid aaya tha jis ke saath ja kar main ne unhein Quran sunaya, chunancha Aap hamein le kar gaye aur un ke nishanaat aur un ki aag ke nishanaat hamein dikhaye. Sha'bi R.H kehte hain unhon ne Aap se tosha talab kiya toh Aamir R.H kehte hain yani Makkah mein aur yeh jinn Jazeere ke thay, toh Aap ne farmaya har woh haddi jis par Allah ka naam zikr kiya gaya ho woh tumhare hathon mein pehle se zyada gosht wali ho kar paray gi, aur leed aur gobar tumhare janwaron ka chara banay ga, pas ae Musalmano! In dono cheezon se istinja na karo yeh tumhare jinn bhaiyon ki khorak hain. Dusri riwayat mein hai ke us raat Huzoor ﷺ ko na pa kar hum bohat hi ghabraye thay aur tamam wadiyon aur ghaatiyon mein talash kar aaye thay aur hadees mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya aaj raat main jinnaat ko Quran sunata raha aur jinnon mein hi isi shughal mein raat guzari. Ibn-e-Jareer R.H mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ki riwayat hai ke Aap ne farmaya tum mein se jo chahe aaj ki raat jinnaat se dilchaspi lene wala mere saath rahe. Pas main majood ho gaya, Aap mujhe le kar chale, jab Makkah Shareef ke oonche hissay mein pohanche toh Aap ne apne paon se ek khat khench diya aur mujh se farmaya bas yahin baithe raho, phir Aap chale aur ek jagah par kharay ho kar Aap ne qirat shuru ki, phir toh is qadar jamaat Aap ke ird-gird that laga kar khari ho gayi ke main toh Aap ki qirat sunne se bhi reh gaya. Phir main ne dekha ke jis tarah abr ke tukray phat-te hain is tarah woh idhar udhar jaane lage aur yahan tak ke ab bohat thoray baqi reh gaye, pas Huzoor ﷺ subh ke waqt farigh huye aur Aap wahan se door nikal gaye aur haajat se farigh ho kar mere paas tashreef laye aur poochne lage woh baqi ke kahan hain? Main ne kaha woh yeh hain, pas Aap ne unhein haddi aur leed di.

Phir Aap ne Musalmanon ko in dono cheezon se istinja karne se mana farma diya. Is riwayat ki dusri sanad mein hai ke jahan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ko bithaya tha wahan bithakar farma diya tha ke khabardar yahan se nikalna nahin warna halak ho jaoge. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne subh ke waqt aakar un se daryaft kiya ke kya tum so gaye the? Aap ne farmaya nahin nahin Allah ki qasam main ne to kayi martaba chaha ke logon se faryad karoon lekin main ne sun liya ke Aap unhein apni lakri se dhamka rahe the aur farmate jate the ke baith jao. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar tum yahan se bahar nikalte to mujhe khauf tha ke in mein ke ba'az tumhein achak na le jayen, phir Aap ne daryaft farmaya ke achha tum ne kuch dekha bhi? Main ne kaha haan log the siyah anjan khaufnak safed kapre pehne hue. Aap ne farmaya yeh (Naseebain) ke jinn the unhon ne mujh se tosha talab kiya tha pas main ne haddi aur leed gobar diya. Main ne pucha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is se unhein kya fayda? Aap ne farmaya har haddi un ke hath lagte hi aisi ho jayegi jaisi us waqt thi jab khayi gayi thi yani gosht wali ho kar unhein milegi aur leed mein bhi wahi dane payenge jo us roz the jab woh dane khaye gaye the. Pas hum mein se koi shakhs bait-ul-khala se nikal kar haddi, leed aur gobar se istinja na kare. Is riwayat ki dusri sanad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya pandrah jinnat jo aapas mein chachazad aur phuphizad bhai hain aaj raat mujh se Quran sunne ke liye aane wale hain. Is mein haddi aur leed ke sath koyle ka lafz bhi hai. Ibn Masood (R.A) farmate hain din nikle main usi jagah gaya to dekha ke woh koi sath oont baithne ki jagah hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab jinnat ka izhdaham ho gaya to un ke sardaran ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main inhein idhar udhar kar ke Aap ko is takleef se bacha leta hoon to Aap ne farmaya Allah se zyada mujhe koi bachane wala nahin. Aap farmate hain jinnat wali raat mein mujh se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke kya tumhare paas pani hai? Main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pani to nahin albata ek dolchi nabeed hai to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya umda khajoorein aur pakeeza pani (Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah). Musnad Ahmad ki is hadith mein hai ke Aap ne farmaya mujhe is se wuzu karao chunancha main ne wuzu karaya aur farmaya yeh to peene ki aur pak cheez hai, jab Aap laut kar aaye to saans charh raha tha main ne pucha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya baat hai? Aap ne farmaya mere paas mere inteqal ki khabar aayi hai. Yehi hadith qadre ziyadati ke sath Hafiz Abu Naeem ki kitab Dalail-un-Nubuwwah mein bhi hai is mein hai ke main ne yeh sun kar kaha phir Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne ba'ad kisi ko khalifa namzad kar jaiye. Aap ne kaha kis ko? Main ne kaha Abu Bakr (R.A) ko. Is par Aap khamosh ho gaye chalte chalte phir kuch der ba'ad yehi halat tari hui. Main ne wahi sawal kiya Aap ne wahi jawab diya. Main ne khalifa muqarrar karne ko kaha Aap ne pucha kise?

Main ne kaha Umar ko (R.A) is par aap khamosh ho gaye, kuch door chalne ke baad phir yahi halat aur yahi sawal jawab hue. Ab ki martaba main ne Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib ka naam pesh kiya to aap farmane lage us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke agar yeh log un ki ita'at karein to sab jannat mein chale jayenge lekin yeh hadith bilkul hi ghareeb hai aur bahut mumkin hai ke yeh mehfooz na ho aur agar sehat tasleem kar li jaye to is waqiye ko Madina ka waqiya manna padega. Wahan bhi aap ke paas jinnon ke wufood aaye thay jaise ke hum anqareeb Insha'Allah Ta'ala bayan karenge is liye ke aap ka aakhri waqt Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad tha jab ke Deen-e-Ilahi mein insaanon aur jinnon ki faujein dakhil ho gayin aur Surah (Iza Ja'a) al-kh, utar chuki jis mein aap ko khabar-e-inteqal di gayi thi. Jaise ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai aur Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ki is par muwafiqat hai jo hadeesein hum isi Surah ki tafseer mein layenge Insha'Allah, Wallahu A'lam. Mandarja bala hadith dusri sanad se bhi marwi hai lekin is ki sanad bhi ghareeb hai aur siyaq bhi ghareeb hai. Hazrat Ikrama farmate hain yeh jinnaat Jazeerah-e-Musal ke thay un ki tadaad barah hazar ki thi. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) is khat kashida ki jagah mein baithe hue thay lekin jinnaat ke khajooron ke darakhton ke barabar ke qad-o-qamat waghera dekh kar dar gaye aur bhaag jana chaha lekin farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yaad aa gaya ke is had se bahar na nikalna. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya agar tum is had se bahar aa jate to Qayamat tak hamari tumhari mulaqat na ho sakti aur riwayat mein hai ke jinnaat ki yeh jamaat jin ka zikr aayat (وَ اِذْ صَرَفْنَاۤ اِلَیْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ یَسْتَمِعُوْنَ الْقُرْاٰنَ ۚ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوْهُ قَالُوْۤا اَنْصِتُوْا ۚ فَلَمَّا قُضِیَ وَلَّوْا اِلٰی قَوْمِهِمْ مُّنْذِرِیْنَ) (46-Al-Ahqaf: 29) mein hai Nainawa ki thi. Aap ne farmaya tha ke mujhe hukum diya gaya ke inhe Quran sunao tum mein se mere saath kaun chalega? Is par sab khamosh ho gaye, dobara pucha phir khamoshi rahi, teesri martaba daryaft kiya to qabeela-e-Huzail ke shakhs Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) tayyar hue. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inhe saath le kar Hajoon ki ghati mein gaye. Ek lakeer khench kar inhe yahan bitha diya aur aap aage badh gaye. Yeh dekhne lage ke gadhon ki tarah ke zameen ke qareeb udte hue kuch janwar aa rahe hain, thodi der baad bada ghul-ghapada sunayi dene laga yahan tak ke mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaat par dar lagne laga. Jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye to main ne kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh shor-o-ghul kya tha? Aap ne farmaya un ke ek maqtool ka qissa tha jis mein yeh mukhtalif thay un ke darmiyan sahih faisla kar diya gaya. Yeh waqiyat saaf hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qasdan ja kar jinnaat ko Quran sunaya, inhe Islam ki dawat di aur jin masail ki us waqt inhe zaroorat thi woh sab bata diye.

Haan pehli martaba jab jinnaat ne aap ki zabani Quran suna us waqt aap ko na maloom tha na aap ne unhein sunane ki gharz se Quran padha tha jaise ke Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain is ke baad woh wufood ki surat mein aaye aur Huzoor ﷺ amdan tashreef le gaye aur unhein Quran sunaya. Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood R.A Rasool Allah ﷺ ke sath us waqt na thay jabke aap ne un se baat cheet ki unhein Islam ki dawat di albatta kuch fasle par door baithe hue thay. Aap ke sath is waqiye mein siwaye Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood R.A ke aur koi na tha aur dusri tatbeeq in riwayaat mein jin mein hai ke aap ke sath Ibn Mas'ood R.A thay aur jin mein hai ke na thay yeh bhi ho sakti hai ke pehli dafa na thay dusri martaba thay. Wallahu A'lam, yeh bhi marwi hai ke Nakhla mein jin jinnon ne aap se mulaqat ki thi woh Nainawa ke thay aur Makkah Shareef mein jo aap ki khidmat mein hazir hue thay woh (Naseebain) ke thay. Aur yeh jo riwayaton mein aaya hai ke hum ne woh raat bahut buri basar ki is se murad Ibn Mas'ood R.A ke siwa aur sahaba hain jinhein is baat ka ilm na tha ke Huzoor ﷺ jinnaat ko Quran sunane gaye hain. Lekin yeh ta'weel hai zara door ki Wallahu A'lam. Baihaqi mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ki haajat aur wuzu ke liye aap ke sath Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A pani ki dolchi liye hue jaya karte thay ek din yeh peeche peeche pohanche aap ne poocha kaun hai? Jawab diya ke main Abu Hurairah hoon farmaya mere istinje ke liye patthar lao lekin haddi aur leed na lana main apni jholi mein patthar bhar laya aur aap ke paas rakh diye jab aap farigh ho chuke aur chalne lage main bhi aap ke peeche chala aur poocha Huzoor kya wajah hai jo aap ne haddi aur leed se mana farma diya? Aap ne jawab diya mere paas (Naseebain) ke jinnon ka wafd aaya tha aur unhon ne mujh se tosha talab kiya tha to main ne Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se dua ki ke woh jis leed aur haddi par guzrein use ta'am payein. Sahih Bukhari mein bhi is ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai pas yeh hadith aur is se pehle ki hadithein dalalat karti hain ke jinnaat ka wafd aap ke paas is ke baad bhi aaya tha ab hum in ahadees ko bayan karte hain jo dalalat karti hain ke jinnaat aap ke paas kayi dafa hazir hue. Ibn Abbas R.A se jo riwayat is se pehle bayan ho chuki hai is ke siwa bhi aap se dusri sanad se marwi hai Ibn Jareer mein hai aap farmate hain yeh saat jin thay (Naseebain) ke rehne wale unhein Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne apni taraf se qasid bana kar jinnaat ki taraf bheja tha Mujahid kehte hain yeh jinnaat tadaad mein saat thay (Naseebain) ke thay un mein se Rasool Allah ﷺ ne teen ko Ahl-e-Harran se kaha aur chaar ko Ahl-e-(Naseebain) se un ke naam yeh hain: Hassi, Hassa, Mansi, Sahir, Nasir, Al-Urdubiyan, Al-Ahtam. Abu Hamza Shamali farmate hain unhein Banu Shaisiyan kehte hain yeh qabeela jinnaat ke aur qabeelon se tadaad mein bahut zyada tha aur yeh un mein nasab ke bhi shareef maane jaate thay aur umooman yeh Iblees ke lashkaron mein se thay Ibn Mas'ood R.A farmate hain yeh nau thay un mein se ek ka naam Radeea tha asal Nakhla se aaye thay.

Ba'az hazrat se marvi hai ke yeh pandrah thay aur ek riwayat mein hai ke saath oonton par aaye thay aur un ke sardar ka naam Wardan tha aur kaha gaya hai ke teen sau thay aur yeh bhi marvi hai ke barah hazar thay. In sab mein tatbiq yeh hai ke chunke wufood kayi ek aaye thay mumkin hai ke kisi mein chhay saat nau hi hon kisi mein zyada kisi mein us se bhi zyada. Is par daleel Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki yeh riwayat bhi hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) jis cheez ki nisbat jab kabhi kehte ke mere khayal mein yeh is tarah hogi toh woh umooman usi tarah nikalti. Ek martaba aap baithe hue thay toh ek haseen shakhs guzra aap ne use dekh kar farmaya agar mera guman ghalat na ho toh yeh shakhs apne jahiliyat ke zamane mein in logon ka kahan tha, jana zara ise le aana. Jab woh aa gaya toh aap ne apna yeh khayal us par zahir farmaya, woh kehne laga musalmanon mein is zahanat-o-fatanat ka koi shakhs aaj tak meri nazar se nahin guzra. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya ab main tujh se kehta hoon ke tu apni koi sahih aur sachi khabar suna, us ne kaha bahut achha suniye main jahiliyat ke zamane mein in ka kahan tha mere paas mera jin jo sab se zyada ta'ajjub khaiz khabar laya woh suniye. Main ek martaba bazar ja raha tha toh woh aa gaya aur sakht ghabrahat mein tha aur kehne laga kya tu ne jinnon ki barbadi mayusi aur unke phailne ke baad simat jana aur un ki dargat nahin dekhi? Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmane lage yeh sacha hai. Main ek martaba in ke buton ke paas soya hua tha ek shakhs ne wahan ek bachhra charhaya ke nagahan ek sakht pur-zor aawaz aayi aisi ke itni buland aur karakht aawaz main ne kabhi nahin suni. Us ne kaha ae Jalih! Nijat dene wala amr aa chuka, ek shakhs hai jo faseeh zaban se aayat (La ilaha illallah) ki munadi kar raha hai. Sab log toh mare dar ke bhag gaye lekin main wahin baitha raha ke dekhun aakhir yeh kya hai? Ke dobara phir isi tarah wahi aawaz sunayi di aur us ne wahi kaha, pas kuch hi din guzre thay jo Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwat ki aawazein hamare kanon mein parne lagein. Is riwayat se zahir alfaz se toh yeh maloom hota hai ke khud Hazrat Farooq (R.A) ne yeh aawazein is zibah shuda bachhre se sunin aur ek za'eef riwayat mein sareeh taur par yeh aa bhi gaya hai lekin baqi aur riwayatein yeh batla rahi hain ke isi kahan ne apne dekhne sunne ka ek waqia yeh bhi bayan kiya, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Baihaqi (R.H) ne yahi kaha hai aur yahi kuch achha maloom hota hai. Is shakhs ka naam Sawad bin Qarab tha jo shakhs is waqia ki poori tafseel dekhna chahta ho woh meri kitab Seerat-e-Umar dekh le, (Wallahul Hamdu wal Minnah). Imam Baihaqi (R.H) farmate hain mumkin hai yahi woh kahan ho jis ka zikr baghair naam ke sahih hadith mein hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) mimbar-e-Nabawi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ek martaba khutba suna rahe thay isi mein poocha kya Sawad bin Qarab yahan maujood hain? Lekin is poore saal tak kisi ne haan nahin kahi, agle saal aap ne phir poocha toh Hazrat Bara (R.A) ne kaha Sawad bin Qarab kaun hai? Is se kya matlab hai?

Aap ne farmaya is ke Islam lane ka qissa ajeeb-o-ghareeb hai. Abhi yeh baatein ho hi rahin thin jo Hazrat Sawad bin Qarab aa gaye. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne un se kaha Sawad apne Islam ka ibtidai qissa sunao. Aap ne farmaya suniye, main Hind gaya hua tha, mera saathi jinn ek raat mere paas aaya, main us waqt soya hua tha, mujhe us ne jaga diya aur kehne laga uth aur agar kuch aql-o-hosh hain to sun le, samajh le aur soch le, Qabeela Lu'ayy bin Ghalib mein se Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mab'oos ho chuke hain. Main jinnaat ki hiss aur un ke boriya bistar bandhne par ta'ajjub kar raha hoon, agar tu talib-e-hidayat hai to foran Makkah ki taraf kooch kar. Samajh le ke behtar aur badtar jinn yaksaan nahin, ja jaldi ja aur Banu Hashim ke is dulare ke munawwar mukhde par nazrein to daal le. Mujhe phir ghunoodgi si aa gayi to us ne dobara jagaya aur kehne laga, ae Sawad bin Qarab! Allah Azzawajal ne apna Rasool bhej diya hai, tum un ki khidmat mein pahuncho aur hidayat aur bhalai samet lo. Dusri raat phir aaya aur mujhe jaga kar kehne laga, mujhe jinnaat ke justuju karne aur jald jald paalan aur jholen kasne par ta'ajjub maloom hota hai, agar tu bhi hidayat ka talib hai to Makkah ka qasd kar. Samajh le ke us ke dono qadam us ki dumon ki tarah nahin, to uth aur jaldi jaldi Banu Hashim ke is pasandida shakhs ki khidmat mein pahunch aur apni aankhein us ke deedar se munawwar kar. Teesri raat phir aaya aur kehne laga, mujhe jinnaat ke bakhabar ho jaane aur un ke qafilon ke foran taiyaar ho jaane par ta'ajjub aa raha hai, woh sab talab-e-hidayat ke liye Makkah ki taraf daude ja rahe hain, un mein ke bure bhalon ki barabari nahin kar sakte, tu bhi uth aur is Banu Hashim ke chida shakhs ki taraf chal khada ho. Momin jinnaat kafiron ki tarah nahin. Teen raaton tak barabar yahi sunte rehne ke baad mere dil mein bhi daf'atan Islam ka walwala utha aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki waqat aur mohabbat se dil pur ho gaya. Main ne apni sandni par kajawa kasa aur baghair kisi jagah qayam kiye seedha Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Aap us waqt shehar-e-Makkah mein the aur log aap ke aas paas aise the jaise ghode par ayal. Mujhe dekhte hi yakbargi Allah ke Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Sawad bin Qarab ko marhaba ho, aao humein maloom hai ke kaise aur kis liye aur kis ke kehne sunne se aa rahe ho. Main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne kuch ashaar kahe hain agar ijazat ho to pesh karoon?

Aap ne farmaya sawad shauq se kaho to Hazrat Sawad ne woh ashaar parhay jin ka mazmoon yeh hai ke mere paas mera jinn mere so jaane ke baad raat ko aaya aur us ne mujhe ek sachi khabar pohanchayi, teen raatein barabar woh mere paas aata raha aur har raat kehta raha ke Lu'ay bin Ghalib mein Allah ke Rasool mab'oos ho chuke hain, main ne bhi safar ki tayari kar li aur jald jald raah tay karta yahan pohanch hi gaya, ab meri gawahi hai ke bajuz Allah ke aur koi Rabb nahin aur aap Allah ke amanatdar Rasool hain, aap se shafa'at ka aasra sab se zyada hai, ae behtareen buzurgon aur paak logon ki aulad, ae tamam Rasoolon se behtar Rasool, jo hukm-e-aasmani aap hamein pohanchayenge woh kitna hi mushkil aur tabiyat ke khilaf kyun na ho namumkin ke hum usay taal dein, aap Qayamat ke din zaroor mere safarishi banna kyunke wahan bajuz aap ke Sawad bin Qaarib ka safarishi aur kaun hoga? Is par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bohat hansay aur farmanay lagay Sawad tum ne falah pa li. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne yeh waqea sun kar poocha kya woh jinn ab bhi tere paas aata hai? Us ne kaha jab se main ne Quran parha woh nahin aata aur Allah ka bada shukr hai ke is ke ewaz main ne Rabb ki paak kitab payi. Aur ab jis hadith ko hum Hafiz Abu Na'eem ki kitab Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah se naqal karte hain is mein bhi is ka bayan hai ke Madina Sharif mein bhi jinnaat ka wafd Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein baryab hua tha. Hazrat Amr bin Ghailan Saqafi, Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ke paas ja kar un se daryaft karte hain ke mujhe yeh maloom hua ke jis raat jinnaat ka wafd hazir-e-Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hua tha us raat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath aap bhi thay? Jawab diya ke haan theek hai, main ne kaha zara waqea to sunaiye. Farmaya Suffah walay masakeen sahaba ko log apne apne sath shaam ka khana khilane le gaye aur main yunhi reh gaya, mere paas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka guzar hua, poocha kaun hai? Main ne kaha Ibn-e-Masood, farmaya tumhein koi nahin le gaya ke tum bhi kha lete? Main ne jawab diya nahin koi nahin le gaya, farmaya achha mere sath chalo, shayad kuch mil jaye to de doon ga, main sath ho liya, aap Hazrat Umme Salma (R.A) ke hujray mein gaye, main bahar hi thehar gaya, thori der mein andar se ek laundi aayi aur kehne lagi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hum ne apne ghar mein koi cheez nahin payi tum apni khwab-gah mein chale jao. Main wapas masjid mein aa gaya aur masjid mein kankriyon ka ek chota sa dher kar ke us par sar rakh kar apna kapra lapet kar so gaya, thori hi der guzri hogi to wohi laundi phir aayi aur kaha Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ko yaad farma rahe hain, sath ho liya aur mujhe umeed paida ho gayi ke ab to khana zaroor mile ga, jab main apni jagah pohancha to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghar se bahar tashreef laye, aap ke hath mein khajoor ke darakht ki ek chhari thi jisay mere seenay par rakh kar farmanay lagay jahan main ja raha hoon kya tum bhi mere sath chalo ge?

Main ne kaha jo Allah ne chaha ho, teen martaba yehi sawal jawab huye, phir aap chale aur main bhi aap ke sath chalne laga. Thodi der mein Baqi-e-Gharqad ja pahunche, phir qareeb qareeb wahi bayan hai jo oopar ki riwayaton mein guzar chuka hai. Is ki sanad ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein ek mubham rawi hai jis ka naam zikr nahin kiya gaya. Dalail-e-Nabuwwat mein Hafiz Abu Naeem farmate hain ke Madina ki masjid mein Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne subah ki namaz ada ki aur laut kar logon se kaha: Aaj raat ko jinnaat ke wafd ki taraf tum mein se kaun mere sath chalega? Kisi ne jawab na diya, teen martaba farman par bhi koi na bola. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas se guzre aur mera hath tham kar apne sath le chale. Madina ke pahadon se bahut aage nikal kar saaf chatil maidan mein pahunch gaye. Ab nezon ke barabar lambe lambe qad ke aadmi neeche neeche kapde pehne huye aane shuru huye hain. Main to unhein dekh kar mare dar ke kanpne laga, phir aur waqia misl-e-hadith-e-Ibn-e-Masood ke bayan kiya. Yeh hadith bhi ghareeb hai, wallahu a'lam.

Isi kitab mein ek ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah ke sathi hajj ko ja rahe the, raste mein hum ne dekha ke ek safed rang ka saanp raste mein lot raha hai aur us mein se mushk ki khushbu ud rahi hai. Ibrahim kehte hain main ne apne sathiyon se kaha tum to sab jao, main yahan thehar jata hoon, dekhun to is saanp ka kya hota hai? Chunancha woh chal diye aur main thehar gaya. Thodi hi der guzri hogi jo woh saanp mar gaya. Main ne ek safed kapda le kar us mein lapet kar raste ke ek taraf dafan kar diya aur raat ke khane ke waqt apne qafle mein pahunch gaya. Allah ki qasam main baitha hua tha jo char auratein maghrib ki taraf aayin, un mein se ek ne poocha: Amr ko kis ne dafan kiya? Hum ne kaha kaun Amr? Us ne kaha tum mein se kisi ne ek saanp ko dafan kiya hai? Main ne kaha haan main ne dafan kiya hai. Kehne lagi qasam hai Allah ki tum ne bade rozedar, bade pukhta namazi ko dafan kiya hai jo tumhare Nabi ko manta tha aur jis ne aap ke Nabi hone se char sau saal peshtar aasman se aap ki sifat suni thi. Ibrahim kehte hain is par hum ne Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ki. Phir hajj se farigh ho kar jab hum Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ki khidmat mein pahunche aur main ne aap ko yeh sara waqia sunaya to aap ne farmaya: Is aurat ne sach kaha. Main ne Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke mujh par iman laya tha meri nabuwwat ke char sau saal pehle. Yeh hadith bhi ghareeb hai, wallahu a'lam.

Ek riwayat mein hai ke dafan-o-kafan karne wale Hazrat Safwan bin Mu'attal (R.A) the. Kehte hain ke yeh sahib jo yahan dafan kiye gaye, yeh un nau jinnaat mein se ek hain jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas Quran sunne ke liye wafd ban kar aaye the, un ka inteqal un sab se akhir mein hua. Abu Naeem mein ek riwayat hai ke ek shakhs Hazrat Usman Zun-Noorain (R.A) ki khidmat mein aaye aur kehne lage: Ameer-ul-Momineen! Main ek jangal mein tha, main ne dekha ke do saanp aapas mein khoob lad rahe hain yahan tak ke ek ne dusre ko maar dala.

Ab main unhein chhor kar jahan ma'arka hua tha wahan gaya toh bahut se saanp qatl kiye hue pare hain aur ba'az se Islam ki khushbu aa rahi hai pas main ne ek ek ko soonghna shuru kiya yahan tak ke ek zard rang ke duble patle saanp se mujhe Islam ki khushbu aane lagi, main ne apne amame mein lapet kar use dafna diya ab main chala ja raha tha jo main ne ek aawaz suni ke ae Allah ke bande tujhe Allah ki taraf se hidayat di gayi. Yeh dono saanp jinnaat ke qabila Banu Shaiban aur Banu Qais mein se thay. In dono mein jang hui aur phir jis qadar qatl hue woh tum ne khud dekh liye inhi mein ek shaheed jinhein tum ne dafn kiya woh thay jinhon ne khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani Wahi-e-Ilahi suni thi. Hazrat Usman (R.A) is qisse ko sun kar farmane lage ae shakhs agar tu sacha hai toh is mein shak nahin ke tu ne ajab waqia dekha aur agar tu jhoota hai toh jhoot ka bojh tujh par hai. Ab aayat ki tafsir suniye irshad hai ke jab hum ne teri taraf jinnaat ke ek giroh ko phera jo Quran sun raha tha jab woh hazir ho gaye aur tilawat shuru hone ko thi toh unhon ne aapas mein ek dusre ko yeh adab sikhaya ke khamoshi se suno. Un ka ek aur adab bhi hadith mein aaya hai Tirmidhi waghera mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Sahaba-e-Kiram ke samne Surah Rahman ki tilawat ki phir farmaya kya baat hai? Jo tum sab khamosh hi rahe tum se toh bahut achhe jawab dene wale jinnaat sabit hue jab bhi mere munh se unhon ne aayat (فَبِاَيِّ اٰلَاۗءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبٰنِ 13) (55. Ar-Rahman: 13) suni unhon ne jawab mein kaha (Wala bishai'in min ala'ika au na'amika Rabbana nukazzibu falakal hamd) phir farmata hai jab faraghat hasil ki gayi (Qaza) ke ma'ani in aayaton mein bhi yahi hain aayat (فَاِذَا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلٰوةُ فَانْتَشِرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَابْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِ اللّٰهِ وَاذْكُرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ 10) (62. Al-Jumu'ah: 10) aur aayat (فَقَضٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمٰوَاتٍ فِيْ يَوْمَيْنِ وَاَوْحٰى فِيْ كُلِّ سَمَاۗءٍ اَمْرَهَا ۭ وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاۗءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيْحَ ڰ وَحِفْظًا ۭ ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيْرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ 12) (41. Fussilat: 12) aur aayat (فَاِذَا قَضَيْتُمْ مَّنَاسِكَكُمْ) (2. Al-Baqarah: 200) woh apni qoum ko dhamkane aur unhein aagah karne ke liye wapas un ki taraf chale jaise Allah Azza-wa-Jal-o-Ala ka farman hai aayat (فَلَوْلَا نَفَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ فِرْقَــةٍ مِّنْھُمْ طَاۗىِٕفَةٌ لِّيَتَفَقَّهُوْا فِي الدِّيْنِ وَلِيُنْذِرُوْا قَوْمَھُمْ اِذَا رَجَعُوْٓا اِلَيْهِمْ لَعَلَّھُمْ يَحْذَرُوْنَ) (9. At-Tawbah: 122), yani woh deen ki samajh hasil karein aur jab wapas apni qoum ke paas pahunchein toh unhein bhi hoshiyar kar dein bahut mumkin hai ke woh bacha'o ikhtiyar kar lein. Is aayat se istidlal kiya gaya hai ke jinnaat mein bhi Allah ki baton ko pahunchane wale aur dar sunane wale hain lekin un mein se Rasool nahin banaye gaye yeh baat bila-shak sabit hai ke jinnon mein paighambar nahin hain.

Farman-e-Bari Ta'ala hai, Ayat: (Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan nuhi ilaihim fas'alu ahlaz-zikri in kuntum la ta'lamun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 7), ya'ni hum ne tujh se pehle bhi jitne rasool bheje woh sab bastiyon ke rehne wale insaan hi thay jin ki taraf hum apni wahi bheja karte thay aur ayat mein hai, Ayat: (Wama arsalna qablaka minal-mursaleena illa innahum layakulunat-ta'ama wa yamshuna fil-aswaqi, wa ja'alna ba'dakum liba'din fitnatan, atasbirun, wa kana Rabbuka basira) (Surah Al-Furqan: 20), ya'ni tujh se pehle hum ne jitne rasool bheje woh sab khana khate thay aur bazaron mein chalte phirte thay. Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) ki nisbat Quran mein hai, Ayat: (Wa ja'alna fi zurriyyatihin-nubuwwata wal-kitaba wa atainahu ajrahu fid-dunya, wa innahu fil-akhirati laminas-saliheen) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 27), ya'ni hum ne un ki aulad mein nubuwwat aur kitab rakh di, pas aap (A.S) ke baad jitne bhi nabi aaye woh aap hi ke khandan aur aap hi ki nasl mein se hue hain. Lekin Surah An'am ki ayat: (Ya ma'sharal-jinni wal-insi alam ya'tikum rusulum minkum yaqussuna alaikum ayati wa yunzirunakum liqa'a yaumikum hadha) (Surah Al-An'am: 130), ya'ni ae jinnon aur insanon ke giroh! Kya tumhare paas tum mein se rasool nahin aaye thay? Is ka matlab aur is se murad yeh dono jins hain, pas is ka misdaq ek jins hi ho sakti hai, jaise farman: (Yakhruju minhumal-lu'lu'u wal-marjan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 22), ya'ni in dono samundaron mein se moti aur moonga nikalta hai, halankeh darasal ek mein se hi nikalta hai.

Iman-dar jinnon ki aakhri manzil ab bayan ho raha hai jinnaat ke us wa'z ka jo unhon ne apni qoum mein kiya. Farmaya ke hum ne is kitab ko suna hai jo Hazrat Musa A.S ke baad nazil hui hai, Hazrat Isa A.S ki kitab Injeel ka zikr is liye chhor diya ke woh darasal Taurat puri karne wali thi. Is mein zyada tar wa'z ke aur dil ko narm karne ke bayanaat thay, haram halal ke masail bohat kam thay, pas asal cheez Taurat hi rahi, isi liye un muslim jinnaat ne isi ka zikr kiya aur isi baat ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar Hazrat Waraqa bin Naufal R.A ne jis waqt Huzoor ﷺ ki zabani Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ke awwal dafa aane ka haal suna to kaha tha ke wah wah yahi to woh mubarak wajood Allah ke bhedi ka hai jo Hazrat Musa A.S ke paas aaya karte thay, kaash ke main aur kuch zamana zinda rehta, al-kh. Phir Quran ki aur sifat bayan karte hain ke woh apne se pehle tamam aasmani kitabon ko sacha batlata hai, woh aitqadi masail aur ikhbari masail mein haq ki janib rehbari karta hai aur aamal mein rah-e-rast dikhata hai. Quran mein do cheezein hain ya khabar ya talab, pas is ki khabar sachi aur is ki talab adl wali. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wa tammat kalimatu rabbika sidqan wa adlan la mubaddila li kalimatihi wa huwas sami'ul aleem) (Surah Al-An'am: 115) yani tere Rab ka kalma sachai aur adl ke lihaz se bilkul pura hi hai aur aayat mein Allah Subhanuhu Wa Ta'ala farmata hai aayat (Huwallazi arsala rasulahu bil huda wa deenil haq) woh Allah jis ne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur haq deen ke sath bheja hai, pas hidayat nafa dene wala ilm hai aur deen-e-haq nek amal hai, yahi maqsad jinnaat ka tha. Phir kehte hain ae hamari qoum Allah ke da'i ki da'wat par labbaik kaho. Is mein dalalat hai is amr ki ke Rasool Allah ﷺ jinn-o-ins ki dono jama'aton ki taraf Allah ki taraf se Rasool bana kar bheje gaye hain, is liye ke aap ne jinnaat ko Allah ki taraf da'wat di aur un ke samne Quran-e-Kareem ki woh Surah parhi jis mein un dono jama'aton ko mukhatib kiya gaya hai aur un ke naam ahkaam jari farmaye hain aur wa'da-o-wa'eed bayan kiya hai yani Surah Ar-Rahman. Phir farmate hain aisa karne se woh tumhare ba'z gunah bakhsh dega. Lekin yeh is surat mein ho sakta hai jab lafz 'min' ko zaida na maanein, chunancha ek qaul mufassireen ka yeh bhi hai aur qa'ide ke mutabiq isbaat ke mauqa par lafz 'min' bohat hi kam zaid aata hai aur agar zaid maan liya jaye to matlab yeh hua ke Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah maaf farmaye ga aur tumhein apne alamnaak azab se woh chhutkara pa lenge, yahi un ki nek aamaliyon ka badla hai aur agar is se zyada martaba bhi unhein milne wala hota to is maqam par yeh momin jinn use zaroor bayan kar dete. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke momin jinn jannat mein nahin jayenge is liye ke woh Iblees ki aulad se hain aur aulad-e-Iblees jannat mein nahin jayegi. Lekin haq yeh hai ke momin jinn misl imandar insanon ke hain aur woh jannat mein jagah payenge jaisa ke salaf ki ek jama'at ka mazhab hai, ba'z logon ne is par is aayat se istidlal kiya hai.

Aayat (Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jaann 56) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 56) yani hooran-e-behishti ko ahl-e-jannat se pehle na kisi insaan ka haath laga na kisi jinn ka. Lekin is istidlal mein nazar hai, is se bahut behtar istidlal toh Allah Azzawajal ke is farman se hai aayat (Wa liman khafa maqama rabbihi jannatan 46) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 46) yani jo koi apne Rab ke samne khara hone se darr gaya us ke liye do do jannatein hain, phir ae jino aur insano tum apne Parwardigar ki kaunsi ne'mat ko jhutlate ho? Is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala insano aur jino par apna ehsan jatata hai ke un ke nek-kar ka badla jannat hai aur is aayat ko sun kar musalman insano se bahut zyada shukr-guzar hain, aisa toh nahin ho sakta ke un ke samne un par woh ehsan jataya jaye jo asal unhein milne ka nahin. Aur bhi hamari ek daleel suniye, jab kafir jinnaat ko jahannam mein dala jayega jo maqam-e-adl hai toh momin jinnaat ko jannat mein kyun na le jaya jaye jo maqam-e-fazl hai? Balkeh yeh bahut zyada laiq aur bator-e-aula hone ke qabil hai aur is par woh aayatein bhi daleel hain jin mein aam taur par imandaron ko jannat ki khushkhabri di gayi hai, maslan aayat (Innal lazina amanu wa amilus salihati kanat lahum jannatul firdawsi nuzula) (Surah Al-Kahf: 107) waghera waghera, yani imandaron ka mehman khana yaqeenan jannat-e-firdaws hai. Alhamdulillah main ne is masle ko bahut kuch wazahat ke sath apni ek mustaqil tasneef mein bayan kar diya hai. Aur suniye, jannat ka toh yeh haal hai ke imandaron ke kul ke dakhil ho jane ke baad bhi is mein be-had-o-hisab jagah bach rahegi aur phir ek nayi makhlooq paida kar ke unhein is mein abad kiya jayega. Phir koi wajah nahin ke imandar aur nek amal wale jinnaat jannat mein na bheje jayen. Aur suniye, yahan do baatein bayan ki gayi hain: gunahon ki bakhshish aur azabon se rihayi, aur jab yeh dono cheezein hain toh yaqeenan yeh mustalzim hain dukhool-e-jannat ko. Is liye ke aakhirat mein ya jannat hai ya jahannam, pas jo shakhs jahannam se bacha liya gaya woh qatan jannat mein jana chahiye aur koi nass-e-sareeh ya zahir is baat ke bayan mein warid nahin hui ke momin jinn bawajood dozakh se bach jane ke jannat mein nahin jayenge. Agar koi is qisam ki saaf daleel ho toh beshak hum us ke manne ke liye tayyar hain, Wallahu A'lam. Nuh A.S ko dekhiye, apni qoum se farmate hain Allah tumhare gunahon ko (ba-wajah iman lane ke) bakhsh dega aur ek waqt-e-muqarrar tak tumhein mohlat dega.

Toh yahan bhi dakhool-e-Jannat ka zikr na hone se yeh lazim nahin aata ke Hazrat Nuh A.S ki qoum ke musalman Jannat mein nahin jayenge balkeh bil-ittifaq woh sab Jannati hain, pas isi tarah yahan bhi samajh lijiye. Ab chand aur aqwal bhi is masle mein sun lijiye. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H se marwi hai ke beech Jannat mein toh yeh pahunchenge nahin, albatta kinaron par idhar udhar rahenge. Baaz log kehte hain Jannat mein toh woh honge lekin duniya ke bilkul bar-aks insan unhein dekhenge aur yeh insanon ko dekh nahin sakenge. Baaz logon ka qaul hai ke woh Jannat mein khayenge piyenge nahin, sirf tasbeeh-o-tahmeed-o-taqdees ka ta'am hoga jaise farishte, is liye ke yeh bhi unhi ki jins se hain. Lekin in tamam aqwal mein nazar hai aur sab be-daleel hain. Phir Momin-e-Waiz farmate hain ke jo Allah ke da'i ki dawat ko qabool na karega woh zameen mein Allah Ta'ala ko hara nahin sakta balkeh qudrat-e-Allah is par shamil aur use ghere hue hai, is ke azabon se unhein koi bacha nahin sakta, yeh khule behkawe mein hain. Khayal farmaiye ke tableegh ka yeh tareeqa kitna pyara aur kis qadar mu'assar hai, raghbat bhi dilayi aur dhamkaya bhi. Isi liye in mein se aksar theek ho gaye aur qafle ke qafle aur faujein ban kar kayi kayi baar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein baryab hue aur Islam qabool kiya, jaise ke pehle mufassalan hum ne bayan kar diya hai, jis par hum Janab-e-Bari ke ehsan ke shukar guzar hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Iman-dar jinnon ki aakhri manzil ab bayan ho raha hai jinnaat ke us wa'z ka jo unhon ne apni qoum mein kiya. Farmaya ke hum ne is kitab ko suna hai jo Hazrat Musa A.S ke baad nazil hui hai, Hazrat Isa A.S ki kitab Injeel ka zikr is liye chhor diya ke woh darasal Taurat puri karne wali thi. Is mein zyada tar wa'z ke aur dil ko narm karne ke bayanaat thay, haram halal ke masail bohat kam thay, pas asal cheez Taurat hi rahi, isi liye un muslim jinnaat ne isi ka zikr kiya aur isi baat ko pesh-e-nazar rakh kar Hazrat Waraqa bin Naufal R.A ne jis waqt Huzoor ﷺ ki zabani Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ke awwal dafa aane ka haal suna to kaha tha ke wah wah yahi to woh mubarak wajood Allah ke bhedi ka hai jo Hazrat Musa A.S ke paas aaya karte thay, kaash ke main aur kuch zamana zinda rehta, al-kh. Phir Quran ki aur sifat bayan karte hain ke woh apne se pehle tamam aasmani kitabon ko sacha batlata hai, woh aitqadi masail aur ikhbari masail mein haq ki janib rehbari karta hai aur aamal mein rah-e-rast dikhata hai. Quran mein do cheezein hain ya khabar ya talab, pas is ki khabar sachi aur is ki talab adl wali. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wa tammat kalimatu rabbika sidqan wa adlan la mubaddila li kalimatihi wa huwas sami'ul aleem) (Surah Al-An'am: 115) yani tere Rab ka kalma sachai aur adl ke lihaz se bilkul pura hi hai aur aayat mein Allah Subhanuhu Wa Ta'ala farmata hai aayat (Huwallazi arsala rasulahu bil huda wa deenil haq) woh Allah jis ne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur haq deen ke sath bheja hai, pas hidayat nafa dene wala ilm hai aur deen-e-haq nek amal hai, yahi maqsad jinnaat ka tha. Phir kehte hain ae hamari qoum Allah ke da'i ki da'wat par labbaik kaho. Is mein dalalat hai is amr ki ke Rasool Allah ﷺ jinn-o-ins ki dono jama'aton ki taraf Allah ki taraf se Rasool bana kar bheje gaye hain, is liye ke aap ne jinnaat ko Allah ki taraf da'wat di aur un ke samne Quran-e-Kareem ki woh Surah parhi jis mein un dono jama'aton ko mukhatib kiya gaya hai aur un ke naam ahkaam jari farmaye hain aur wa'da-o-wa'eed bayan kiya hai yani Surah Ar-Rahman. Phir farmate hain aisa karne se woh tumhare ba'z gunah bakhsh dega. Lekin yeh is surat mein ho sakta hai jab lafz 'min' ko zaida na maanein, chunancha ek qaul mufassireen ka yeh bhi hai aur qa'ide ke mutabiq isbaat ke mauqa par lafz 'min' bohat hi kam zaid aata hai aur agar zaid maan liya jaye to matlab yeh hua ke Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah maaf farmaye ga aur tumhein apne alamnaak azab se woh chhutkara pa lenge, yahi un ki nek aamaliyon ka badla hai aur agar is se zyada martaba bhi unhein milne wala hota to is maqam par yeh momin jinn use zaroor bayan kar dete. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke momin jinn jannat mein nahin jayenge is liye ke woh Iblees ki aulad se hain aur aulad-e-Iblees jannat mein nahin jayegi. Lekin haq yeh hai ke momin jinn misl imandar insanon ke hain aur woh jannat mein jagah payenge jaisa ke salaf ki ek jama'at ka mazhab hai, ba'z logon ne is par is aayat se istidlal kiya hai.

Aayat (Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jaann 56) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 56) yani hooran-e-behishti ko ahl-e-jannat se pehle na kisi insaan ka haath laga na kisi jinn ka. Lekin is istidlal mein nazar hai, is se bahut behtar istidlal toh Allah Azzawajal ke is farman se hai aayat (Wa liman khafa maqama rabbihi jannatan 46) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 46) yani jo koi apne Rab ke samne khara hone se darr gaya us ke liye do do jannatein hain, phir ae jino aur insano tum apne Parwardigar ki kaunsi ne'mat ko jhutlate ho? Is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala insano aur jino par apna ehsan jatata hai ke un ke nek-kar ka badla jannat hai aur is aayat ko sun kar musalman insano se bahut zyada shukr-guzar hain, aisa toh nahin ho sakta ke un ke samne un par woh ehsan jataya jaye jo asal unhein milne ka nahin. Aur bhi hamari ek daleel suniye, jab kafir jinnaat ko jahannam mein dala jayega jo maqam-e-adl hai toh momin jinnaat ko jannat mein kyun na le jaya jaye jo maqam-e-fazl hai? Balkeh yeh bahut zyada laiq aur bator-e-aula hone ke qabil hai aur is par woh aayatein bhi daleel hain jin mein aam taur par imandaron ko jannat ki khushkhabri di gayi hai, maslan aayat (Innal lazina amanu wa amilus salihati kanat lahum jannatul firdawsi nuzula) (Surah Al-Kahf: 107) waghera waghera, yani imandaron ka mehman khana yaqeenan jannat-e-firdaws hai. Alhamdulillah main ne is masle ko bahut kuch wazahat ke sath apni ek mustaqil tasneef mein bayan kar diya hai. Aur suniye, jannat ka toh yeh haal hai ke imandaron ke kul ke dakhil ho jane ke baad bhi is mein be-had-o-hisab jagah bach rahegi aur phir ek nayi makhlooq paida kar ke unhein is mein abad kiya jayega. Phir koi wajah nahin ke imandar aur nek amal wale jinnaat jannat mein na bheje jayen. Aur suniye, yahan do baatein bayan ki gayi hain: gunahon ki bakhshish aur azabon se rihayi, aur jab yeh dono cheezein hain toh yaqeenan yeh mustalzim hain dukhool-e-jannat ko. Is liye ke aakhirat mein ya jannat hai ya jahannam, pas jo shakhs jahannam se bacha liya gaya woh qatan jannat mein jana chahiye aur koi nass-e-sareeh ya zahir is baat ke bayan mein warid nahin hui ke momin jinn bawajood dozakh se bach jane ke jannat mein nahin jayenge. Agar koi is qisam ki saaf daleel ho toh beshak hum us ke manne ke liye tayyar hain, Wallahu A'lam. Nuh A.S ko dekhiye, apni qoum se farmate hain Allah tumhare gunahon ko (ba-wajah iman lane ke) bakhsh dega aur ek waqt-e-muqarrar tak tumhein mohlat dega.

Toh yahan bhi dakhool-e-Jannat ka zikr na hone se yeh lazim nahin aata ke Hazrat Nuh A.S ki qoum ke musalman Jannat mein nahin jayenge balkeh bil-ittifaq woh sab Jannati hain, pas isi tarah yahan bhi samajh lijiye. Ab chand aur aqwal bhi is masle mein sun lijiye. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H se marwi hai ke beech Jannat mein toh yeh pahunchenge nahin, albatta kinaron par idhar udhar rahenge. Baaz log kehte hain Jannat mein toh woh honge lekin duniya ke bilkul bar-aks insan unhein dekhenge aur yeh insanon ko dekh nahin sakenge. Baaz logon ka qaul hai ke woh Jannat mein khayenge piyenge nahin, sirf tasbeeh-o-tahmeed-o-taqdees ka ta'am hoga jaise farishte, is liye ke yeh bhi unhi ki jins se hain. Lekin in tamam aqwal mein nazar hai aur sab be-daleel hain. Phir Momin-e-Waiz farmate hain ke jo Allah ke da'i ki dawat ko qabool na karega woh zameen mein Allah Ta'ala ko hara nahin sakta balkeh qudrat-e-Allah is par shamil aur use ghere hue hai, is ke azabon se unhein koi bacha nahin sakta, yeh khule behkawe mein hain. Khayal farmaiye ke tableegh ka yeh tareeqa kitna pyara aur kis qadar mu'assar hai, raghbat bhi dilayi aur dhamkaya bhi. Isi liye in mein se aksar theek ho gaye aur qafle ke qafle aur faujein ban kar kayi kayi baar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein baryab hue aur Islam qabool kiya, jaise ke pehle mufassalan hum ne bayan kar diya hai, jis par hum Janab-e-Bari ke ehsan ke shukar guzar hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke kya un logon ne jo marne ke baad jeene ke munkir hain aur Qayamat ke din jismon samet jee uthne ko muhaal jaante hain yeh nahin dekha ke Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ne kul aasmanon aur tamam zameenon ko paida kiya aur un ki paidaish ne use kuch na thakaya balkay sirf 'hoja' ke kehne se hi hogayin. Kaun tha jo us ke hukm ki khilaf-warzi karta ya mukhalifat karta balkay hukm-bardari se raazi khushi dare dabte sab majood hogaye, kya itni kaamil qudrat-o-quwwat wala murdon ke zinda kar dene ki sakat nahin rakhta? Chunancha dusri aayat mein hai aayat (Lakhulqus-samawati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqin-nasi wa lakinna aksaran-nasi la ya'lamun) (40. Ghafir: 57) yani insanon ki paidaish se toh bohat bhaari aur mushkil aur bohat badi ahem paidaish aasman-o-zameen ki hai lekin aksar log be-samajh hain. Jab zameen-o-aasman ko us ne paida kar diya toh insaan ka paida kar dena khwah ibtidaan ho khwah dobara ho us par kya mushkil hai? Isi liye yahan bhi farmaya ke haan woh har shay par qadir hai aur unhi mein se maut ke baad zinda karta hai ke us par bhi woh sahih taur par qadir hai. Phir Allah Jalla-o-Ula kafiron ko dhamkata hai ke Qayamat wale din Jahannam mein daale jayenge, us se pehle Jahannam ke kinare par unhein khada kar ke ek martaba phir la-jawab aur be-hujjat kiya jayega aur kaha jayega kyun ji hamare wade aur yeh dozakh ke azaab ab toh sahih nikle ya ab bhi shak-o-shuba aur inkar-o-takzeeb hai? Yeh jaadu toh nahin tumhari aankhein toh andhi nahin hogayin? Jo dekh rahe ho sahih dekh rahe ho ya dar-haqiqat sahih nahin? Ab siwaye iqrar ke kuch na ban padega, jawab denge ke haan haan sab haq hai jo kaha gaya tha wahi nikla, qasam Allah ki ab hamein ratti barabar bhi shak nahin. Allah farmaye ga ab do ghadi pehle ke kufr ka maza chakho. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tasalli de raha hai ke aap ki qaum ne agar aap ko jhutlaya, aap ki qadr na ki, aap ki mukhalifat ki, eeza-rasani ke darpaye hue toh yeh koi nayi baat thodi hi hai? Agle Ulul-Azm paighambaron ko yaad karo ke kaisi kaisi eezayein, museebatein aur takleefein bardasht keen aur kin kin zabardast mukhalifon ki mukhalifat ko sabr se bardasht kiya. Un rasoolon ke naam yeh hain: Nuh (A.S), Ibrahim (A.S), Musa (A.S), Isa (A.S), aur Khatam-ul-Anbiya (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), Allahumma Salli Alaihim Ajma'een. Anbiya ke bayan mein un ke naam khusoosiyat se Surah Ahzab aur Surah Shura mein mazkoor hain aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Ulul-Azm Rasool se murad sab paighambar hon toh (minar-rusul) ka (min) bayan-e-jins ke liye hoga, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne roza rakha phir bhooke hi rahe phir roza rakha phir bhooke hi rahe aur phir roza rakha phir farmane lage: Ayesha! Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Aal-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke laiq toh duniya hai hi nahin.

Aisha duniya ki balaon aur museebaton par sabr karne aur duniya ki khwahish ki cheezon se apne tayein bachaye rakhne ka hukm Ulul-Azm Rasoolon ko diye gaye aur wahi takleef mujhe bhi di gayi hai jo un aali himmat Rasoolon ko di gayi thi. Qasam Allah ki main bhi inhi ki tarah apni taqat bhar sabr-o-sahar se hi kaam loonga Allah ki quwwat ke bharose se par yeh baat zaban se nikal raha hoon. Phir farmaya ae Nabi (ﷺ) yeh log azabon mein mubtala kiye jayen is ki jaldi na karo. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Fazarni wa man yukazzibu bihazal hadithi sanastadrijuhum min haithu la ya'lamun) (68. Al-Qalam: 44), yani kafiron ko mohlat do, unhein thodi der chhod do phir farmata hai jis din yeh in cheezon ka mushahida kar lenge jin ke wade aaj diye jate hain us din unhein maloom hone lagega ke duniya mein sirf din ka kuch hi hissa guzara hai aur aayat mein hai aayat (Ka'annahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbasu illa ashiyyatan aw duhaha) (79. An-Nazi'at: 46) yani jis din yeh Qayamat ko dekh lenge to aisa maloom hoga ke goya duniya mein sirf ek subh ya ek sham hi guzari thi (Wa yawma yahshuruhum ka'an lam yalbasu illa sa'atan minan nahari yata'arafuna bainahum qad khasirallazina kazzabu biliqa'illahi wa ma kanu muhtadeen) (10. Yunus: 45) yani jis din hum unhein jama karenge to yeh mehsoos karne lagenge ke goya din ki ek sa'at hi duniya mein rahe the phir farmaya pahuncha dena hai. Is ke do ma'ani ho sakte hain ek to yeh ke duniya ka theharna sirf hamari taraf se hamari baton ke pahuncha dene ke liye tha dusre yeh ke yeh Quran sirf pahuncha dene ke liye hai yeh khuli tableegh hai phir farmata hai siwaye fasiqon ke aur kisi ko halaki nahin. Yeh Allah Jalla Wa 'Ala ka adl hai ke jo khud halak hua use hi woh halak karta hai azab usi ko hote hain jo khud apne hathon apne liye azab muhayya kare aur apne aap ko mustahiq-e-azab kar de Wallahu A'lam.

Jab zameen-o-aasman ko us ne paida kar diya toh insaan ka paida kar dena khwah ibtidaan ho khwah dobara ho us par kya mushkil hai? Isi liye yahan bhi farmaya ke haan woh har shay par qadir hai aur unhi mein se maut ke baad zinda karta hai ke us par bhi woh sahih taur par qadir hai. Phir Allah Jalla-o-Ula kafiron ko dhamkata hai ke Qayamat wale din Jahannam mein daale jayenge, us se pehle Jahannam ke kinare par unhein khada kar ke ek martaba phir la-jawab aur be-hujjat kiya jayega aur kaha jayega kyun ji hamare wade aur yeh dozakh ke azaab ab toh sahih nikle ya ab bhi shak-o-shuba aur inkar-o-takzeeb hai? Yeh jaadu toh nahin tumhari aankhein toh andhi nahin hogayin? Jo dekh rahe ho sahih dekh rahe ho ya dar-haqiqat sahih nahin? Ab siwaye iqrar ke kuch na ban padega, jawab denge ke haan haan sab haq hai jo kaha gaya tha wahi nikla, qasam Allah ki ab hamein ratti barabar bhi shak nahin. Allah farmaye ga ab do ghadi pehle ke kufr ka maza chakho. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tasalli de raha hai ke aap ki qaum ne agar aap ko jhutlaya, aap ki qadr na ki, aap ki mukhalifat ki, eeza-rasani ke darpaye hue toh yeh koi nayi baat thodi hi hai? Agle Ulul-Azm paighambaron ko yaad karo ke kaisi kaisi eezayein, museebatein aur takleefein bardasht keen aur kin kin zabardast mukhalifon ki mukhalifat ko sabr se bardasht kiya. Un rasoolon ke naam yeh hain: Nuh (A.S), Ibrahim (A.S), Musa (A.S), Isa (A.S), aur Khatam-ul-Anbiya (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), Allahumma Salli Alaihim Ajma'een. Anbiya ke bayan mein un ke naam khusoosiyat se Surah Ahzab aur Surah Shura mein mazkoor hain aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Ulul-Azm Rasool se murad sab paighambar hon toh (minar-rusul) ka (min) bayan-e-jins ke liye hoga, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne roza rakha phir bhooke hi rahe phir roza rakha phir bhooke hi rahe aur phir roza rakha phir farmane lage: Ayesha! Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Aal-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke laiq toh duniya hai hi nahin.

Aisha duniya ki balaon aur museebaton par sabr karne aur duniya ki khwahish ki cheezon se apne tayein bachaye rakhne ka hukm Ulul-Azm Rasoolon ko diye gaye aur wahi takleef mujhe bhi di gayi hai jo un aali himmat Rasoolon ko di gayi thi. Qasam Allah ki main bhi inhi ki tarah apni taqat bhar sabr-o-sahar se hi kaam loonga Allah ki quwwat ke bharose se par yeh baat zaban se nikal raha hoon. Phir farmaya ae Nabi (ﷺ) yeh log azabon mein mubtala kiye jayen is ki jaldi na karo. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Fazarni wa man yukazzibu bihazal hadithi sanastadrijuhum min haithu la ya'lamun) (68. Al-Qalam: 44), yani kafiron ko mohlat do, unhein thodi der chhod do phir farmata hai jis din yeh in cheezon ka mushahida kar lenge jin ke wade aaj diye jate hain us din unhein maloom hone lagega ke duniya mein sirf din ka kuch hi hissa guzara hai aur aayat mein hai aayat (Ka'annahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbasu illa ashiyyatan aw duhaha) (79. An-Nazi'at: 46) yani jis din yeh Qayamat ko dekh lenge to aisa maloom hoga ke goya duniya mein sirf ek subh ya ek sham hi guzari thi (Wa yawma yahshuruhum ka'an lam yalbasu illa sa'atan minan nahari yata'arafuna bainahum qad khasirallazina kazzabu biliqa'illahi wa ma kanu muhtadeen) (10. Yunus: 45) yani jis din hum unhein jama karenge to yeh mehsoos karne lagenge ke goya din ki ek sa'at hi duniya mein rahe the phir farmaya pahuncha dena hai. Is ke do ma'ani ho sakte hain ek to yeh ke duniya ka theharna sirf hamari taraf se hamari baton ke pahuncha dene ke liye tha dusre yeh ke yeh Quran sirf pahuncha dene ke liye hai yeh khuli tableegh hai phir farmata hai siwaye fasiqon ke aur kisi ko halaki nahin. Yeh Allah Jalla Wa 'Ala ka adl hai ke jo khud halak hua use hi woh halak karta hai azab usi ko hote hain jo khud apne hathon apne liye azab muhayya kare aur apne aap ko mustahiq-e-azab kar de Wallahu A'lam.

Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke kya un logon ne jo marne ke baad jeene ke munkir hain aur Qayamat ke din jismon samet jee uthne ko muhaal jaante hain yeh nahin dekha ke Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ne kul aasmanon aur tamam zameenon ko paida kiya aur un ki paidaish ne use kuch na thakaya balkay sirf 'hoja' ke kehne se hi hogayin. Kaun tha jo us ke hukm ki khilaf-warzi karta ya mukhalifat karta balkay hukm-bardari se raazi khushi dare dabte sab majood hogaye, kya itni kaamil qudrat-o-quwwat wala murdon ke zinda kar dene ki sakat nahin rakhta? Chunancha dusri aayat mein hai aayat (Lakhulqus-samawati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqin-nasi wa lakinna aksaran-nasi la ya'lamun) (40. Ghafir: 57) yani insanon ki paidaish se toh bohat bhaari aur mushkil aur bohat badi ahem paidaish aasman-o-zameen ki hai lekin aksar log be-samajh hain.
